Ab_Crunch_Machine.name: Machine Crunch
steps: Set the seat so the handles or pads sit at your upper chest, then sit down and hook your feet under the rollers.
Hold the handles and brace your stomach.
Curl your chest down towards your hips by rounding your upper back, moving slowly.
Pause when your stomach is fully squeezed, then let the pad rise back slowly.
Move with your stomach muscles, not by pulling with your arms.

Ab_Roller.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel on the floor below your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and tuck your hips slightly so your lower back stays flat.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, letting your hips and chest lower together, as far as you can keep your back from sagging.
Pull the wheel back towards your knees using your stomach until you return to the start.
Shorten the distance you roll out if your lower back starts to arch.

Active_Hang.name: Active Hang
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears without bending your elbows.
Hold that position, chest slightly lifted.
Step down with control when the time is up.

Air_Bike.name: Air Bike
steps: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Push and pull the handles while you pedal.
Go harder to increase the resistance.
Pedal easy for a few minutes to cool down.

Alternate_Hammer_Curl.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl, Alternating
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing your thighs.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder, palm still facing in.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
Repeat with the other arm, and keep alternating.
Keep your upper arms still and don't swing your body to lift the weight.

Alternating_Renegade_Row.name: Kettlebell Renegade Row
steps: Set two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder-width apart and hold the handles in a high plank, arms straight and feet wide.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line.
Row one kettlebell up to the side of your ribs, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it back to the floor with control, then row with the other arm.
Keep your hips level and facing the floor; widen your feet if they twist.

American_Kettlebell_Swing.name: American Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your hips, holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell all the way overhead, bottom pointing up.
Let it fall back between your legs and go into the next rep.

Anderson_Squat.name: Anderson Squat
steps: Set the bar on the safety pins at the height of your bottom squat position.
Get under the bar so it sits on your upper back, feet set as for a squat.
Drive up from a dead stop to standing.
Lower the bar back onto the pins with control and reset.

Archer_Push-Up.name: Archer Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands about twice shoulder-width apart.
Lower towards one hand, bending that arm while keeping the other arm straight.
Push back up to the middle.
Alternate sides each rep, or finish the set on one side and switch.

Arm_Circles.name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand with your arms straight out to the sides.
Make small circles forward, gradually making them bigger.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your shoulders down and your arms straight.

Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.name: Arnold Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you and elbows in front.
Press the dumbbells up while turning your palms to face forwards, finishing with your arms straight above your shoulders.
Lower them slowly, turning your palms back to face you as they return to the start.
Keep your back against the pad and don't arch your lower back to finish the press.

Ball_Leg_Curl.name: Ball Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your arms on the floor at your sides and your heels on top of an exercise ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Pull the ball towards you by bending your knees, keeping your hips high.
Straighten your legs slowly to roll the ball back out.
Keep your hips up throughout; don't let them drop as the ball rolls away.

Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
steps: Loop a resistance band around a pull-up bar and pull one end through the other so it's secure.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away, slightly wider than your shoulders, and put one knee or foot in the band.
Start from a hang with straight arms, then pull your chest up towards the bar until your chin is above it.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a lighter band as you get stronger, since the band takes less of your body weight.

Band_Bent-Over_Row.name: Band Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand on a band and hinge forward holding the ends, back flat.
Row your hands towards your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.

Band_Clamshell.name: Band Clamshell
steps: Lie on your side with a loop band above your knees, hips and knees bent.
Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee against the band.
Don't let your hips roll back.
Lower; finish the set and switch sides.

Band_Curl.name: Band Curl
steps: Stand on a band holding the ends underhand.
Curl your hands up to your shoulders, elbows at your sides.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

Band_Dead_Bug.name: Band Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back holding a band anchored behind your head, arms pointing up, knees above your hips.
Extend one leg towards the floor.
Bring it back and extend the other.
Keep your arms still and your lower back down.

Band_Deadlift.name: Band Deadlift
steps: Stand on the middle of a band and hinge down to grip it, back flat.
Stand up tall, driving your hips forward.
Lower with control.
Keep the band close to your legs.

Band_Face_Pull.name: Band Face Pull
steps: Anchor a band at face height and hold an end in each hand.
Pull towards your face, elbows high and hands apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return with control.

Band_Fire_Hydrant.name: Band Fire Hydrant
steps: Get on your hands and knees with a loop band above your knees.
Lift one knee out to the side against the band.
Lower with control.
Finish the set and switch legs.

Band_Front_Raise.name: Band Front Raise
steps: Stand on a band holding the ends at your thighs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Band_Glute_Bridge.name: Band Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with a loop band just above your knees, feet flat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Lower with control.

Band_Glute_Kickback.name: Band Glute Kickback
steps: Get on your hands and knees with a band looped around one foot and held under your hands.
Push that foot back until your leg is straight.
Squeeze your glute.
Return; finish the set and switch legs.

Band_Good_Morning.name: Band Good Morning
steps: Stand on a band and loop the other end behind your neck.
Push your hips back and lower your torso towards level.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

Band_Hammer_Curl.name: Band Hammer Curl
steps: Stand on a band holding the ends with your palms facing in.
Curl your hands up to your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

Band_Hip_Thrust.name: Band Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a band across your hips, its ends held down under your hands or the bench.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knee to shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

Band_Jump_Squat.name: Band Jump Squat
steps: Stand with a loop band above your knees.
Squat down, pushing your knees out.
Jump as high as you can.
Land softly and go into the next squat.

Band_Lat_Pulldown.name: Band Lat Pulldown
steps: Anchor a band high and kneel facing it, holding an end in each hand.
Pull your hands down to your shoulders, elbows driving down.
Squeeze your lats.
Return with control.

Band_Lateral_Walk.name: Band Lateral Walk
steps: Put a loop band around your legs above your knees or at your ankles.
Get into a quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Walk the set distance, then come back the other way.

Band_Leg_Curl.name: Band Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down with a band anchored low behind you and looped around one ankle.
Curl your heel towards your buttock.
Lower with control.
Finish the set and switch legs.

Band_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand on a band and hold the other end behind your head with both hands.
Straighten your arms overhead.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lower with control.

Band_Pull_Apart.name: Band Pull-Apart
steps: Stand tall and hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start, keeping tension on the band.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and your arms nearly straight.

Band_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Band Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on a band holding the ends at your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower your hands along your legs, knees slightly bent.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

Band_Row_One-Arm.name: Band Row, One-Arm
steps: Anchor a band at chest height and hold it in one hand.
Row it to your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Band_Skull_Crusher.name: Band Skull Crusher
steps: Anchor a resistance band low behind the head end of a flat bench, then lie on the bench holding the band ends.
Point your upper arms straight up with your elbows bent, so your hands are near your forehead.
Straighten your elbows to push your hands up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Bend your elbows slowly to return to the start.
Keep your upper arms still; only your forearms should move.

Band_Squat.name: Band Squat
steps: Stand on a band with your feet shoulder-width apart and loop the other end over your shoulders, or hold it at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Drive back up against the band.
Keep your chest up.

Band_Straight-Arm_Pulldown.name: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Anchor a band high and stand facing it, arms straight in front.
Pull your hands down to your thighs, arms straight.
Squeeze your lats.
Return with control.

Band_Thruster.name: Band Thruster
steps: Stand on a band holding the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up and press your hands overhead.
Lower your hands as you go into the next squat.

Band_Triceps_Kickback.name: Band Triceps Kickback
steps: Stand on a band and hinge forward, holding the end with your upper arm at your side.
Straighten your arm back.
Squeeze at the top.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Band_Triceps_Pushdown.name: Band Triceps Pushdown
steps: Anchor a band high and hold the ends, elbows at your sides.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return with control.

Band_Upright_Row.name: Band Upright Row
steps: Stand on a band holding the ends at your thighs.
Pull your hands up to your chest, elbows high.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Band_Woodchop.name: Band Woodchop
steps: Anchor a band high and stand side-on, holding it with both hands.
Pull it diagonally down across your body to the opposite hip.
Return with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Barbell_21s.name: Barbell 21s
steps: Stand holding a barbell underhand, hands shoulder-width apart.
Do seven half curls from the bottom to halfway up.
Do seven half curls from halfway up to the top.
Finish with seven full curls without resting.

Barbell_Ab_Rollout_-_On_Knees.name: Barbell Rollout
steps: Put round plates of the same size on a barbell so it rolls, then kneel on a mat behind it.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, shoulders above the bar.
Brace your stomach and roll the bar forward slowly, lowering your chest and hips together.
Go as far as you can without your lower back sagging, then pull the bar back to your knees using your stomach.
Keep your hips slightly tucked and stop short if your back starts to arch.

Barbell_Back_Squat_Low_Bar.name: Barbell Back Squat, Low Bar
steps: Set the bar across the back of your shoulders, just below the top of your shoulder blades, and grip it firmly.
Unrack it and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Sit back and down with more forward lean than a high-bar squat until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your mid-foot, keeping the bar over the middle of your feet.

Barbell_Back_Squat_Paused.name: Barbell Back Squat, Paused
steps: Set up as for a back squat with the bar on your upper back.
Squat to the bottom position with control.
Hold the bottom for two to three seconds without relaxing.
Drive back up to standing.

Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift the bar off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest, keeping your elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Keep your hips and shoulder blades on the bench, and use a spotter or safety arms when you train heavy.

Barbell_Bench_Press_Paused.name: Barbell Bench Press, Paused
steps: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar with your bench press grip.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Hold it still on your chest for one to two seconds.
Press it back up to straight arms.

Barbell_Bench_Press_Reverse_Grip.name: Barbell Bench Press, Reverse Grip
steps: Lie on the bench and grip the bar underhand, a little wider than your shoulders.
Unrack it and lower it to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up to straight arms.
Use a spotter; the grip is less secure.

Barbell_Bulgarian_Split_Squat.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back and stand about a stride in front of a flat bench.
Rest the top of your rear foot on the bench, front foot flat on the floor.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is level and your rear knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up, then switch legs after the set.

Barbell_Cuban_Press.name: Barbell Cuban Press
steps: Stand holding a light barbell with a wide overhand grip at your thighs.
Pull it up until your upper arms are level with the floor, elbows out.
Rotate your forearms up so the bar is above your elbows, then press it overhead.
Reverse the movement back down.

Barbell_Curl.name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart and arms straight.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back or swing to lift the bar.

Barbell_Curl_Close_Grip.name: Barbell Curl, Close Grip
steps: Stand holding a barbell underhand with your hands a little closer than shoulder-width.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders, elbows at your sides.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower it with control.

Barbell_Curl_Wide_Grip.name: Barbell Curl, Wide Grip
steps: Stand holding a barbell underhand with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders, elbows at your sides.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower it with control.

Barbell_Deadlift.name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs, arms straight.
Flatten your back, brace your stomach and lift your chest so your shoulders are just in front of the bar.
Push the floor away with your legs and stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back first, then bending your knees once it passes them. Keep your back flat throughout.

Barbell_Deadlift_Banded.name: Barbell Deadlift, Banded
steps: Anchor bands under the platform or a heavy dumbbell and loop them over the barbell ends.
Set up for a deadlift with your back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand up, pushing harder as the bands stretch.
Lower the bar to the floor with control.

Barbell_Deadlift_Paused.name: Barbell Deadlift, Paused
steps: Set up for a deadlift and lift the bar off the floor.
Pause for two seconds just below your knees, back flat.
Finish the lift by driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar to the floor with control.

Barbell_Floor_Press.name: Barbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor, knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a barbell over your chest with a grip a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight.
Lower the bar until your upper arms rest on the floor, forearms vertical.
Press the bar back up to straight arms.

Barbell_Frog_Pump.name: Barbell Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back with a padded barbell across your hips, soles of your feet together and knees out.
Hold the bar in place with both hands.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control.

Barbell_Front_Rack_Lunge.name: Barbell Front Rack Lunge
steps: Hold a barbell in the front rack, resting on your shoulders, elbows high.
Step forward with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your elbows up and your torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

Barbell_Front_Raise.name: Barbell Front Raise
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar forward and up, arms straight, until it reaches eye level.
Lower with control.
Don't swing your body.

Barbell_Full_Squat.name: Barbell Back Squat, Full Depth
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height, step under it and place it across your upper back, below your neck.
Lift the bar out, step back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Brace your stomach, then bend your hips and knees together to squat as deep as you can with a flat back, hips below your knees.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your chest up; set the safety bars just below your lowest point.

Barbell_Glute_Bridge.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and roll a padded barbell over your legs until it sits in the crease of your hips.
Lie back, bend your knees and set your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart, holding the bar in place.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down and don't arch your lower back at the top.

Barbell_High_Pull.name: Barbell High Pull
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back slightly, then extend explosively.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high and out.
Lower the bar with control.

Barbell_Hip_Thrust.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench and rest a padded barbell, or a dumbbell held with both hands, across your hips.
Bend your knees and set your feet flat, about hip-width apart, so your shins are upright at the top.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Pause, then lower your hips slowly towards the floor.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down so the movement comes from your hips, not your lower back.

Barbell_Hip_Thrust_Single_Leg.name: Barbell Hip Thrust, Single Leg
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until your body is level from knee to shoulder.
Lower with control, finish the set and switch legs.

Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie back with your eyes under the racked bar and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack, arms straight.
Lower the bar slowly to your upper chest, just below your collarbones.
Press it back up until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together and your back on the bench throughout.

Barbell_Lateral_Lunge.name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet together.
Take a wide step to one side and sit your hips back over that foot, the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet pointing forward.
Push back to the start and switch sides.

Barbell_Lunge.name: Barbell Lunge
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step forward with one leg.
Bend both knees to lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee in line with your toes and your upper body upright.

Barbell_Overhead_Carry.name: Barbell Overhead Carry
steps: Press a barbell overhead and lock your arms out.
Brace your core and keep the bar over the middle of your head.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down.

Barbell_Overhead_Lunge.name: Barbell Overhead Lunge
steps: Press or jerk a barbell overhead with a wide grip and lock your arms.
Step forward with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep the bar over your head and your torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

Barbell_Pullover.name: Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest, hands shoulder-width apart, elbows slightly bent.
Lower the bar back over your head until your arms are in line with your body.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your elbow bend fixed throughout.

Barbell_Rear_Delt_Row.name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Bend forward with a barbell in a wide overhand grip, torso nearly level with the floor.
Row the bar to your upper chest with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the top.
Lower the bar with control.

Barbell_Reverse_Lunge.name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step back and lower your back knee until it is just above the floor.
Keep your front shin upright and your torso tall.
Push through your front foot to step back to the start, then switch legs.

Barbell_Russian_Twist.name: Barbell Russian Twist
steps: Stand holding the end of a landmine barbell at chest height with both hands.
Rotate your torso and swing the bar down to one hip in an arc.
Swing it back up and down to the other hip.
Pivot your feet slightly with each turn.

Barbell_Seated_Calf_Raise.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a plate or block and a padded barbell across your thighs near your knees.
Let your heels drop as low as they go.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

Barbell_Shoulder_Press.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support in a rack and set the bar at about the height of your chin when seated.
Hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, lift it off the rack and hold it just above your upper chest.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower it slowly back to the top of your chest.
Keep your back against the pad and your stomach braced; don't arch to push the bar up.

Barbell_Shrug.name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your arms straight and don't roll your shoulders; move straight up and down.

Barbell_Shrug_Behind_the_Back.name: Barbell Shrug, Behind the Back
steps: Stand holding a barbell behind your thighs with an overhand grip.
Shrug your shoulders up as high as you can.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control.

Barbell_Sissy_Squat.name: Barbell Sissy Squat
steps: Hold a light barbell across your upper back or a plate on your chest, holding a support with one hand.
Rise onto your toes and lean back as you bend your knees forward.
Lower until your knees are well past your toes and your thighs and torso form a straight line.
Push back up through your quads.

Barbell_Skull_Crusher.name: Barbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell over your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar to just above your forehead.
Straighten your arms to press the bar back up.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling, not flaring out.

Barbell_Split_Squat.name: Barbell Split Squat
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back and stand in a long staggered stance, back heel raised.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is level and your back knee is just above the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise, keeping your feet where they are.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

Barbell_Squat.name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and place it across your upper back, below your neck.
Lift the bar out, take a step or two back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your stomach, then push your hips back and bend your knees to squat until your thighs are at least level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and your knees in line with your toes; set the safety bars just below your lowest point.

Barbell_Step_Ups.name: Barbell Step-Up
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height.
Put one whole foot on top of the box.
Push through that foot to step up until you're standing tall on the box, bringing your other foot up beside it.
Step down slowly with the foot you brought up last, then repeat.
Drive with the leg on the box and avoid pushing off with the foot on the floor.

Barbell_Thruster.name: Barbell Thruster
steps: Hold a barbell in the front rack on your shoulders, grip just outside them, elbows high.
Squat down until your thighs are level, torso upright.
Drive up out of the squat and, in one movement, press the bar overhead to straight arms.
Lower the bar to your shoulders as you go down into the next squat.

Barbell_Walking_Lunge.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, in a clear space.
Take a long step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand and bring your back foot forward into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk forward.
Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your toes.

Bayesian_Curl.name: Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in one hand with your arm behind you.
Step forward so the cable pulls your arm back.
Curl the handle up, keeping your elbow behind your body.
Lower with control; finish the set and switch sides.

Behind-the-Back_Wrist_Curl.name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
steps: Stand holding a barbell behind your thighs, palms facing back.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl it back up into your palms and flex your wrists.
Lower with control.

Bench_Dips.name: Bench Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers over the edge.
Straighten your arms and move your hips forward off the bench, legs out in front with heels on the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips towards the floor until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms again.
Keep your back close to the bench and your elbows pointing behind you, not out to the sides.

Bench_Press_-_With_Bands.name: Band Bench Press
steps: Loop a resistance band around each end of a barbell and anchor the bands to the bench frame or to the floor below it.
Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor, and hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift the bar off the rack and lower it slowly to the middle of your chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight; the bands pull harder as the bar rises.
Control the bar on the way down so the bands don't pull it into your chest, and use a spotter.

Bent-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands cupping one end.
Bend your elbows clearly, more than for a straight-arm pullover, and keep that bend throughout.
Lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your chest and under your arms.
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your hips on the bench and don't lower further than your shoulders are comfortable with.

Bent-Over_Barbell_Row_Wide_Underhand.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row, Wide Underhand
steps: Bend forward holding a barbell underhand, hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep your back flat and your torso at about 45 degrees.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower it with control.

Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
steps: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders, standing with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back to lean forward until your upper body is close to level with the floor, arms straight.
Pull the bar to your lower chest or upper stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat and your upper body still; don't stand up to move the bar.

Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in, and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back to lean forward, back flat and arms hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower the dumbbells slowly.
Keep your back flat and your neck in line with it throughout.

Bird_Dog.name: Bird Dog
steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold for a moment without letting your hips tilt.
Return to the start and switch sides.

Boat_Hold.name: Boat Hold
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Lean back and lift your feet so your shins are level with the floor.
Reach your arms forward and hold, keeping your back straight.
Straighten your legs to make it harder.

Bodyweight_Bulgarian_Split_Squat.name: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand about a stride in front of a bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand, finish the set and switch legs.

Bodyweight_Calf_Raise.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step, or flat on the floor, and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you comfortably can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Keep your knees straight but not locked, and don't bounce at the bottom.

Bodyweight_Good_Morning.name: Bodyweight Good Morning
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and lower your torso towards parallel with the floor, knees slightly bent.
Keep your back flat throughout.
Squeeze your glutes to bring your torso back up.

Bodyweight_Lateral_Lunge.name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet together, hands in front of your chest.
Take a wide step to one side and sit your hips back over that foot, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep both feet flat and pointing forward.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start, then switch sides.

Bodyweight_Reverse_Lunge.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips.
Step back with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front shin close to vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front foot to step back to the start, then switch legs.

Bodyweight_Single-Leg_Deadlift.name: Bodyweight Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting the free leg extend straight behind you.
Lower until your torso is about parallel to the floor, hips square.
Squeeze the glute of the standing leg to return upright, then switch legs.

Bodyweight_Squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly and arms in front of you for balance.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself as far as you comfortably can, ideally until your thighs are level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your chest up, your heels on the floor and your knees in line with your toes.

Bodyweight_Sumo_Squat.name: Bodyweight Sumo Squat
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes turned out about 45 degrees.
Squat straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Go down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, chest up.
Push through your heels to stand.

Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, in a space where you can walk forward.
Take a long step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor, bending both knees.
Push through your front foot and bring your back foot forward into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk.
Keep your upper body upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

Box_Jump.name: Box Jump
steps: Stand facing a box about a foot's length away.
Swing your arms back, bend your knees and jump onto the box.
Land softly on both feet in a squat, then stand tall.
Step down, one foot at a time.

Box_Squat.name: Box Squat
steps: Place a box or bench behind you at a height where your thighs are about level with the floor when you sit on it.
Set a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand in front of the box, feet a little wider than shoulder-width.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to sit down onto the box under control.
Pause briefly while keeping your stomach braced, then push through your feet to stand up.
Sit lightly on the box rather than dropping onto it, and keep your back flat.

Bradford_Press.name: Bradford Press
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your shoulders in front of your head.
Press it up just high enough to clear your head and lower it behind your neck.
Press it back over your head to the front.
Keep alternating front and back.

Broad_Jump.name: Broad Jump
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides.
Swing your arms back and bend your hips and knees into a quarter squat.
Swing your arms forward and jump as far forward as you can.
Land on both feet with bent knees, hold the landing, then walk back.

Burpee.name: Burpee
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position and lower your chest to the floor.
Push up, jump your feet back towards your hands and stand.
Jump straight up with your arms overhead and land softly into the next rep.

Butt_Kicks.name: Butt Kicks
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, kicking each heel up towards your buttocks.
Keep your thighs pointing down and your torso upright.
Stay light on the balls of your feet and keep a quick pace.

Butt_Lift_Bridge.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch at the top.

Butterfly.name: Machine Chest Fly
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles or place your forearms on the pads with your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles.
Let your arms open back slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad and the bend in your elbows the same throughout.

Cable_Anti-Rotation_Hold.name: Cable Anti-Rotation Hold
steps: Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height, holding the handle with both arms straight out.
Hold the position, resisting the pull.
Breathe steadily.
Switch sides.

Cable_Calf_Raise.name: Cable Calf Raise
steps: Stand facing a low pulley on a plate or step, holding a bar at your thighs.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

Cable_Chest_Press.name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Set two pulleys at about chest height, hold a handle in each hand and step forward so the cables are taut, one foot ahead of the other.
Bring your hands beside your chest with your elbows bent and slightly below shoulder height.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight in front of your chest.
Let your hands come back slowly to the sides of your chest.
Keep your stomach braced so your body doesn't sway as you press.

Cable_Chest_Press_One-Arm.name: Cable Chest Press, One-Arm
steps: Stand facing away from a pulley at chest height, holding the handle in one hand.
Press it forward until your arm is straight, without twisting.
Return with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Chest_Press_Split_Stance.name: Cable Chest Press, Split Stance
steps: Stand between two pulleys at chest height in a split stance, a handle in each hand.
Press both handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return with control.
Switch your front foot halfway through.

Cable_Concentration_Curl.name: Cable Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a bench by a low pulley, holding the handle with your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl it up towards your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Cross-Body_Lateral_Raise.name: Cable Cross-Body Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and take the handle in the far hand, so the cable crosses in front of you.
Raise your arm up and out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly across your body.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Cable_Crossover.name: Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys high, hold a handle in each hand and step forward to the middle, one foot ahead of the other.
Lean forward slightly with your arms out to the sides and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands down and together in front of your lower chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest, then let your arms return slowly along the same arc until you feel a stretch.
Keep the bend in your elbows the same throughout; it's a hugging movement, not a press.

Cable_Crunch.name: Cable Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine, holding the rope ends beside your head.
Bend at the hips slightly so the cable is taut, with your back straight.
Curl your chest down towards your knees by rounding your upper back and squeezing your stomach.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your hips still; the movement comes from your stomach, not from sitting back.

Cable_Curl_One-Arm.name: Cable Curl, One-Arm
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a handle in one hand.
Curl it up towards your shoulder, elbow at your side.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Drag_Curl.name: Cable Drag Curl
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar underhand.
Pull your elbows back as you curl, dragging the bar up along your body.
Stop at your lower chest.
Lower along the same path.

Cable_Fly_High_to_Low.name: Cable Fly, High to Low
steps: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, a handle in each hand.
Bring the handles down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your lower chest.
Return with control.

Cable_Fly_Mid_Height.name: Cable Fly, Mid Height
steps: Set both pulleys at chest height and stand in the middle, a handle in each hand.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest.
Return with control.

Cable_Fly_One-Arm.name: Cable Fly, One-Arm
steps: Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height holding the handle in the near hand.
Bring it across in front of your chest in an arc.
Squeeze your chest.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Front_Raise.name: Cable Front Raise
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley with the bar between your legs, or facing it, holding the bar overhand.
Raise the bar forward to shoulder height, arms nearly straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Cable_Front_Raise_Rope.name: Cable Front Raise, Rope
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley holding the rope ends, the rope between your legs.
Raise the rope forward to shoulder height, arms nearly straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Cable_Front_Squat.name: Cable Front Squat
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar across your front shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your elbows up.
Drive back up.

Cable_Glute_Kickback_Bent_Knee.name: Cable Glute Kickback, Bent Knee
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face it, holding the frame.
Keeping the knee bent, push your foot back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Goblet_Squat.name: Cable Goblet Squat
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding the rope at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive back up.

Cable_Hammer_Curls_-_Rope_Attachment.name: Cable Hammer Curl
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end in each hand, palms facing each other.
Stand tall facing the machine with your arms straight and your elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up towards your shoulders, keeping your palms facing each other.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back to lift the weight.

Cable_High_Row.name: Cable High Row
steps: Kneel or sit facing a high pulley holding a rope or two handles.
Row down and back towards your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

Cable_Hip_Abduction.name: Cable Hip Abduction
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and fasten it to your far ankle.
Stand side-on to the pulley.
Lift your leg out to the side.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Hip_Adduction.name: Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and fasten it to your near ankle.
Stand side-on to the pulley.
Pull your leg across in front of the other.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Hip_Flexion.name: Cable Hip Flexion
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing away from it.
Lift the strapped knee forward and up.
Lower with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Internal_Rotation.name: Cable Internal Rotation
steps: Stand side-on to a pulley at elbow height, holding the handle in the near hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm in across your stomach.
Keep your elbow against your side.
Return slowly; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_One_Arm_Tricep_Extension.name: One-Arm Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and hold it with one hand, palm facing down.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked against your side, forearm about level with the floor.
Straighten your arm to push the handle down until your arm is fully straight.
Let your forearm rise slowly back to the start, then switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper arm still at your side; only your forearm should move.

Cable_Overhead_Extension_One-Arm.name: Cable Overhead Extension, One-Arm
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding a handle behind your head with one hand.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Keep your upper arm still.
Lower with control; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Overhead_Triceps_Extension_Bar.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension, Bar
steps: Stand facing away from a high pulley holding a bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms forward and up.
Keep your upper arms still.
Return with control.

Cable_Preacher_Curl.name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a straight bar attached.
Sit with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and hold the bar with an underhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, squeezing your biceps.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad throughout and don't let the weight pull your arms straight quickly.

Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set two pulleys at about shoulder height and stand in the middle.
Cross your arms in front of you and take the left cable in your right hand and the right cable in your left hand.
With your arms nearly straight, pull your hands out and back to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Return slowly until your arms cross in front of you again.
Keep your shoulders down and your elbows slightly bent; don't lean back to move the weight.

Cable_Rear_Delt_Row.name: Cable Rear Delt Row
steps: Face a pulley at chest height holding a rope or two handles.
Row towards your upper chest with your elbows high and flared.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return with control.

Cable_Reverse_Crunch.name: Cable Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your feet towards a low pulley, ankle straps attached.
Pull your knees towards your chest, lifting your hips.
Lower with control.
Keep your back on the floor.

Cable_Reverse_Curl.name: Cable Reverse Curl
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar overhand.
Curl it up to your shoulders, wrists straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Cable_Reverse_Lunge.name: Cable Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a handle in each hand.
Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs.

Cable_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

Cable_Rope_Curl.name: Cable Rope Curl
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding the rope ends, palms facing in.
Curl the rope up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

Cable_Rotation.name: Cable Rotation
steps: Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height, holding the handle with both hands.
Rotate your torso away from the pulley, arms straight.
Return with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Seated_Lateral_Raise.name: Seated Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on a bench side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine, so the cable crosses your body.
Sit tall with your arm slightly bent and your hand in front of your hip.
Raise your arm out to the side until your hand is at shoulder height.
Lower it slowly back across your body, then switch arms after the set.
Lead with your elbow and don't lift your shoulder towards your ear.

Cable_Shoulder_Press.name: Cable Shoulder Press
steps: Place a bench with back support between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Sit with your back against the pad and bring the handles to your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
Keep your back against the pad and your stomach braced; don't arch your lower back.

Cable_Shrug.name: Cable Shrug
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a straight bar at your thighs.
Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.

Cable_Side_Bend.name: Cable Side Bend
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley holding the handle in the near hand.
Bend away from the pulley.
Return to upright with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Split_Squat.name: Cable Split Squat
steps: Stand in a split stance facing a low pulley, holding a handle in each hand.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive back up.
Finish the set and switch legs.

Cable_Squat.name: Cable Squat
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Lean back slightly against the cable.
Drive back up.

Cable_Triceps_Kickback.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
steps: Face a low pulley and hinge forward, holding the handle in one hand, upper arm at your side.
Straighten your arm back.
Squeeze at the top.
Return with control; finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Twisting_Row.name: Cable Twisting Row
steps: Stand facing a pulley at chest height, holding the handle in one hand with your torso turned towards it.
Row the handle back while rotating your torso away.
Return with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Upright_Row.name: Cable Upright Row
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding a straight bar overhand at your thighs.
Pull the bar up along your body to just below your chin, elbows high.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Cable_Upright_Row_Rope.name: Cable Upright Row, Rope
steps: Stand facing a low pulley holding the rope ends at your thighs.
Pull the rope up to your chest, spreading the ends apart, elbows high.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Cable_Woodchop_Low_to_High.name: Cable Woodchop, Low to High
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley holding the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up and across your body above the opposite shoulder.
Return with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cable_Wrist_Curl.name: Cable Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel or sit facing a low pulley with your forearms on a bench, holding a bar underhand.
Let your wrists bend back.
Curl your wrists up.
Lower with control.

Cable_Y_Raise.name: Cable Y Raise
steps: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles with crossed arms, or one handle in one hand.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y above your head.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Sit in the leg press and place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, hip-width apart, with your heels off it.
Press the platform up until your legs are straight but not locked, and release the safety handles.
Push through the balls of your feet to point your toes and move the platform away.
Lower the platform slowly by letting your heels come back towards you until your calves stretch.
Keep your knees straight throughout and keep your feet firmly on the platform.

Cat-Cow.name: Cat-Cow
steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Breathe in and let your stomach drop, lifting your chest and tailbone.
Breathe out and round your back towards the ceiling, tucking your chin.
Move slowly between the two positions.

Chin-Up.name: Chin-Up
steps: Hold a pull-up bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and your stomach braced.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar, bringing your elbows down towards your ribs.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Avoid swinging or kicking your legs to get up.

Clean.name: Clean
steps: Set up over the bar with a grip just outside your legs, back flat.
Lift the bar from the floor and extend your hips and knees explosively.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a front squat.
Stand up with the bar in the front rack.

Clean_High_Pull.name: Clean High Pull
steps: Set up over the bar with your clean grip.
Lift the bar and extend your hips and knees explosively.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high and out.
Lower the bar with control.

Clean_Pull.name: Clean Pull
steps: Set up over the bar with your clean grip.
Lift the bar from the floor as for a clean, keeping it close.
Extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively and shrug at the top.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

Clean_and_Press.name: Clean and Press
steps: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, grip it just outside your legs and set a flat back with your hips above your knees.
Lift the bar by pushing through your legs, then jump it up fast, shrugging and pulling your elbows up.
Drop under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows forward, then stand up.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight overhead, moving your head back out of its path.
Lower the bar to your shoulders, then to your thighs and the floor, keeping your back flat.

Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.name: Barbell Bench Press, Close Grip
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, a little narrower than for a normal bench press.
Lift the bar off the rack and lower it slowly to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Don't bring your hands too close together; keep your wrists straight above your elbows.

Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown, Close Grip
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away and your hands a little narrower than shoulder-width.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing your body to pull the bar down.

Commando_Pull-Up.name: Commando Pull-Up
steps: Stand under the bar side-on and grip it with your hands close together, one in front of the other.
Pull up so your head passes to one side of the bar.
Lower with control, then pull up so your head passes the other side.
Alternate sides each rep.

Concentration_Curls.name: Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Press the back of that upper arm against the inside of your thigh, arm straight and palm facing up.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm against your thigh.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly until your arm is straight, and switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper body still and let only your forearm move.

Cossack_Squat.name: Cossack Squat
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes turned slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down over that leg, keeping the other leg straight with its toes up.
Go as low as you can with your heel flat and your chest up.
Push back to the middle and repeat on the other side.

Cross-Body_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.name: Cross-Body Dumbbell Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell across your body towards the opposite shoulder.
Straighten your arm back up.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Cross-Body_Hammer_Curl.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up and across your body towards the opposite shoulder.
Lower it and curl the other.
Keep your upper arms still.

Cross-Body_Mountain_Climber.name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Drive one knee towards the opposite elbow.
Switch legs quickly, bringing the other knee across.
Keep your hips low and your shoulders over your hands.

Crunches.name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands lightly beside your head or cross them on your chest.
Squeeze your stomach to lift your shoulders off the floor, curling your ribs towards your hips.
Pause briefly, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Don't pull on your head; keep a small gap between your chin and your chest.

Curtsy_Lunge.name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other, crossing it as if curtsying.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to the start, then switch legs.

Dead_Bug.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with your arms pointing straight up and your knees bent above your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your stomach.
Slowly lower one arm behind your head and straighten the opposite leg towards the floor, without touching it.
Bring them back to the start and repeat with the other arm and leg.
Keep your lower back on the floor throughout; don't lower as far if it starts to lift.

Dead_Bug_Arms_Only.name: Dead Bug, Arms Only
steps: Lie on your back with your arms pointing at the ceiling and your knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Lower one arm overhead towards the floor while keeping your legs still.
Bring it back and lower the other arm.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

Dead_Hang.name: Dead Hang
steps: Grip a pull-up bar overhand, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet and hang with your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Breathe steadily and hold for the set time.
Step down with control.

Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured under the pads and your eyes under the racked bar.
Hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack, with a spotter if you can.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together and the bar moving under control.

Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press_Close_Grip.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press, Close Grip
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack it and lower it to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up to straight arms.
Keep the movement controlled.

Decline_Crunch.name: Decline Crunch
steps: Lie back on a decline bench with your knees bent and your feet hooked under the pads.
Cross your arms on your chest, hold a weight plate against it, or place your hands lightly beside your head.
Squeeze your stomach to curl your shoulders off the bench, ribs towards your hips. For a sit-up, keep curling until your chest is near your thighs.
Lower yourself slowly back to the bench without dropping.
Don't pull on your head; keep a small gap between your chin and your chest.

Decline_Dumbbell_Bench_Press.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand on your thighs.
Bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest as you lie back, then press them up above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your lower chest.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and the dumbbells above your elbows.

Decline_Dumbbell_Fly.name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured, dumbbells over your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms out to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

Deficit_Deadlift.name: Deficit Deadlift
steps: Stand on a low platform or plate with the bar over your mid-foot.
Bend down and grip the bar, back flat, hips lower than in a normal deadlift.
Drive through your feet to stand up with the bar.
Lower the bar to the floor with control.

Devil_Press.name: Devil Press
steps: Start with a dumbbell in each hand on the floor and do a burpee, chest touching the floor.
Jump your feet in towards your hands.
Swing the dumbbells between your legs and up overhead in one motion.
Lower them back to the floor and repeat.

Dip_Machine.name: Machine Dip
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are about level with your hips when your arms are bent, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent and pointing back.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until your elbows are bent again.
Keep your shoulders down and your back against the pad.

Dips_-_Chest_Version.name: Chest Dip
steps: Hold the parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Lean your upper body forward and bend your knees, crossing your ankles behind you.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself until you feel a stretch in your chest, letting your elbows flare slightly.
Push back up until your arms are straight, keeping the forward lean.
Stop lowering when your shoulders feel strained; you don't need to go very deep.

Dips_-_Triceps_Version.name: Triceps Dip
steps: Hold the parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Keep your upper body upright and your elbows close to your sides.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and move slowly at the bottom.

Dive_Bomber_Push-Up.name: Dive Bomber Push-Up
steps: Start in a downward dog position with your feet a little wider than hip-width.
Bend your elbows and lower your head and chest forward along the floor.
Straighten your arms and lift your chest, hips low.
Reverse the movement back to the downward dog position.

Double_Kettlebell_Clean.name: Double Kettlebell Clean
steps: Stand with two kettlebells on the floor between your feet, one in each hand.
Hike them back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull both bells into the rack position.
Lower them back between your legs and repeat.

Double_Kettlebell_Swing.name: Double Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet wide, a kettlebell in each hand.
Hinge and swing both bells back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing them to chest height.
Let them fall back and go into the next rep.

Drag_Curl.name: Drag Curl
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up the front of your body to your lower chest.
Keep the bar touching your body and your shoulders back the whole way.
Lower the bar the same way to your thighs.

Dumbbell_Alternate_Bicep_Curl.name: Dumbbell Curl, Alternating
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing your thighs.
Curl one dumbbell up, turning your palm to face up as it rises towards your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly, turning your palm back in.
Repeat with the other arm, and keep alternating.
Keep your elbows by your sides and don't swing your body.

Dumbbell_Around_the_World.name: Dumbbell Around the World
steps: Lie on a bench holding light dumbbells at your thighs, palms up, arms straight.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and over your head in a wide arc.
Sweep them back down to your thighs.
Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh, then lie back, bringing them to the sides of your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Press them back up, bringing them close together at the top.
Keep your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled together on the bench.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press_Alternating.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Alternating
steps: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells over your chest, arms straight.
Lower one dumbbell to your chest while holding the other up.
Press it back up, then lower the other.
Keep alternating.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press_Close_Grip.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Close Grip
steps: Lie on a bench holding the dumbbells close together over your chest, palms facing in.
Lower them to your chest, elbows close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the dumbbells close throughout.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press_Neutral_Grip.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Neutral Grip
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells beside your chest, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press them back up.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press_One-Arm.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, One-Arm
steps: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Lower it to the side of your chest.
Press it back up without letting your body twist.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press_Reverse_Grip.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Reverse Grip
steps: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing your head.
Lower them to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press them back up.
Keep your wrists straight.

Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl.name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back or swing to lift the weight.

Dumbbell_Bulgarian_Split_Squat.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand about a stride in front of a flat bench.
Rest the top of your rear foot on the bench, front foot flat on the floor.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is level and your rear knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up, then switch legs after the set.

Dumbbell_Burpee.name: Dumbbell Burpee
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and place the dumbbells on the floor, then jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back in and stand up holding the dumbbells.
Go straight into the next rep.

Dumbbell_Calf_Raise_Single_Leg.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise, Single Leg
steps: Stand on one foot on a step holding a dumbbell in the same-side hand, other hand on a support.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Lower slowly, finish the set and switch legs.

Dumbbell_Clean.name: Dumbbell Clean
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back to lower the dumbbells to your knees.
Extend explosively and pull the dumbbells up, catching them on your shoulders.
Lower them back to your thighs.

Dumbbell_Cuban_Press.name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
steps: Stand holding light dumbbells at your thighs.
Pull them up until your upper arms are level with the floor, elbows out.
Rotate your forearms up, then press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse the movement down.

Dumbbell_Curtsy_Lunge.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other, crossing it as if curtsying.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

Dumbbell_Dead_Bug.name: Dumbbell Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back holding a light dumbbell in each hand over your chest, knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Lower one arm overhead and extend the opposite leg.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

Dumbbell_Deadlift.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the dumbbells to mid-shin, back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand up tall, hips and knees straight.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs the whole way.

Dumbbell_Drag_Curl.name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back as you curl, dragging the dumbbells up along your body.
Stop at your lower chest.
Lower along the same path.

Dumbbell_Floor_Fly.name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
steps: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms out to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

Dumbbell_Floor_Press.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Pause briefly with your arms on the floor, without relaxing.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.
Let your arms touch the floor lightly instead of dropping onto it.

Dumbbell_Flyes.name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
Don't lower the dumbbells below the level of your shoulders.

Dumbbell_Frog_Pump.name: Dumbbell Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell on your hips, soles of your feet together and knees out.
Pull your heels close to your buttocks.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Front_Rack_Carry.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Carry
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows in front.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Lower the dumbbells when you finish.

Dumbbell_Front_Raise_Alternating.name: Dumbbell Front Raise, Alternating
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Raise one arm forward, nearly straight, to shoulder height.
Lower it and raise the other.
Don't swing your body.

Dumbbell_Front_Squat.name: Dumbbell Front Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, one end resting on each shoulder.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, elbows pointing forward.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel, chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

Dumbbell_Glute_Bridge.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, close to your hips.
Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it at both ends.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees are in a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips to the floor.

Dumbbell_Goblet_Squat.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, both hands cupped under its top end.
Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips, toes turned out slightly.
Squat down until your thighs are at least level, elbows inside your knees, chest up.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.

Dumbbell_Hang_Clean.name: Dumbbell Hang Clean
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Hinge to bring the dumbbells to just above your knees.
Jump and shrug, catching the dumbbells on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand up, then lower them to your sides.

Dumbbell_High_Pull.name: Dumbbell High Pull
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Hinge slightly, then extend your hips explosively.
Pull the dumbbells up to chest height, elbows high and out.
Lower them with control.

Dumbbell_Hip_Thrust.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench, knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it at both ends.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs are level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips back down.

Dumbbell_Incline_Row.name: Incline Dumbbell Row
steps: Set an incline bench to a low angle and lie face down on it, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight.
Keep your chest on the pad and your feet on the floor.
Pull the dumbbells up to the sides of your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the bench throughout; don't lift it to help the weight up.

Dumbbell_Internal_Rotation.name: Dumbbell Internal Rotation
steps: Lie on your side on your working arm's side, elbow bent at 90 degrees, a light dumbbell in that hand.
Rotate the dumbbell up towards your stomach, keeping your elbow in place.
Lower slowly.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Dumbbell_JM_Press.name: Dumbbell JM Press
steps: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows forward, lowering the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Keep your elbows pointing towards your feet.
Press back up to straight arms.

Dumbbell_L_Raise.name: Dumbbell L Raise
steps: Stand holding light dumbbells, one arm at your side and the other in front.
Raise one arm out to the side and the other forward, both to shoulder height.
Lower both together.
Switch arms each rep.

Dumbbell_Lateral_Lunge.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet hip-width apart.
Take a wide step to one side and bend that knee, pushing your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet pointing forward.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start, then repeat on the other side.

Dumbbell_Lateral_Step-Up.name: Dumbbell Lateral Step-Up
steps: Stand side-on to a box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the near foot on the box.
Drive through that foot to stand on the box.
Lower with control, finish the set and switch sides.

Dumbbell_Lunges.name: Dumbbell Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step forward with one leg and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to step back to the start, then repeat with the other leg.
For walking lunges, bring your back foot forward into the next step instead of stepping back.
Keep your upper body upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

Dumbbell_Overhead_Carry.name: Dumbbell Overhead Carry
steps: Press a dumbbell overhead in one or both hands and lock your arms out.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Lower the dumbbells and switch hands if carrying one.

Dumbbell_Overhead_Extension_One-Arm.name: Dumbbell Overhead Extension, One-Arm
steps: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbow.
Keep your upper arm pointing up.
Straighten your arm, finish the set and switch sides.

Dumbbell_Pendlay_Row.name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
steps: Stand over two dumbbells on the floor, torso level with the floor, back flat.
Grip the dumbbells.
Row them explosively to your lower chest.
Lower them back to the floor and let them settle.

Dumbbell_Pistol_Squat.name: Dumbbell Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg holding a light dumbbell out in front of you with both hands.
Extend the other leg forward.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can, using the weight to balance.
Drive back up, finish the set and switch legs.

Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with one or both upper arms on the pad, holding dumbbells underhand.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.

Dumbbell_Pullover_Crunch.name: Dumbbell Pullover Crunch
steps: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell overhead, knees bent.
Pull the dumbbell over your chest while crunching up and bringing your knees in.
Lower back to the start.
Move with control.

Dumbbell_Push_Press.name: Dumbbell Push Press
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms forward.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, torso upright.
Drive up with your legs and use that push to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock your arms out over your head, then lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.

Dumbbell_Rear_Delt_Row.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Bend forward holding a dumbbell in each hand, torso nearly level with the floor.
Row the dumbbells up with your elbows flared out to the sides.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step back with one leg and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to bring your back foot forward to the start.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep most of your weight on your front foot and your upper body upright.

Dumbbell_Reverse_Curl.name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Curl them up to your shoulders with straight wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Reverse_Wrist_Curl.name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your forearms on your thighs, holding dumbbells overhand past your knees.
Let your wrists bend down.
Lift the backs of your hands as far as you can.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Unlock your knees and push your hips back, lowering the dumbbells down the front of your legs.
Stop just below your knees, when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, back flat.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.

Dumbbell_Russian_Twist.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, heels down, and lean back to about 45 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell upright in both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to bring the dumbbell beside one hip.
Twist to the other side, keeping your chest up and your back straight.

Dumbbell_Scaption.name: Dumbbell Scaption
steps: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides, thumbs up.
Raise your arms forward at about 30 degrees out from your body.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Seal_Row.name: Dumbbell Seal Row
steps: Lie face down on a raised flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Row the dumbbells up towards your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward and elbows below your wrists.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Don't lean back or arch your lower back to push the weight up.
