Dumbbell_Shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your arms straight and move straight up and down without rolling your shoulders.

Dumbbell_Side_Bend.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in one hand at your side, other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways towards the dumbbell, letting it slide down your leg.
Use the opposite side of your waist to pull yourself back up to standing.
Finish the set, then switch sides.
Bend only to the side; don't lean forward or back.

Dumbbell_Single-Leg_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting the free leg extend straight behind you.
Lower the dumbbell towards the floor until your torso is about level, hips square.
Return upright, finish the set and switch legs.

Dumbbell_Sit-Up.name: Dumbbell Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell on your chest.
Sit all the way up.
Lower back down with control.
Hook your feet under something if you need to.

Dumbbell_Snatch.name: Dumbbell Snatch
steps: Stand with a dumbbell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and grip it with one hand, back flat.
Extend explosively and pull the dumbbell straight up, punching it overhead.
Lower it back down, finish the set and switch hands.

Dumbbell_Spider_Curl.name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down, holding dumbbells underhand.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Squat.name: Dumbbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your chest up, your heels down and your knees in line with your toes.

Dumbbell_Squeeze_Press.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
steps: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells together over your chest, palms facing each other.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other hard.
Lower them to your chest while keeping them pressed together.
Press back up.

Dumbbell_Step_Ups.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height, with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place one whole foot on the box.
Push through that foot to step up until you're standing tall on the box, bringing your other foot up beside it.
Step down slowly with the foot you brought up last, then repeat.
Drive with the leg on the box and avoid pushing off with the foot on the floor.

Dumbbell_Suitcase_Carry.name: Suitcase Carry
steps: Hold one heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side, the other arm free.
Stand tall with your shoulders level and your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps without leaning towards the weight.
Set the dumbbell down, switch hands and walk back.

Dumbbell_Suitcase_Deadlift.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Stand with a dumbbell on the floor beside one foot.
Squat down with a flat back and grip it, shoulders level.
Stand up without leaning towards the weight.
Lower it back down, finish the set and switch sides.

Dumbbell_Sumo_Squat.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Stand in a wide stance with your toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its top end between your legs.
Squat down until your thighs are near level, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Keep your torso upright and your arms straight.
Push through your feet to stand back up.

Dumbbell_Swing.name: Dumbbell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your hips, holding one dumbbell by an end with both hands.
Hinge and swing the dumbbell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the dumbbell up to chest height.
Let it fall back between your legs and go into the next rep.

Dumbbell_Thruster.name: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Hold a dumbbell on the front of each shoulder, palms facing in.
Squat down until your thighs are level, torso upright.
Drive up out of the squat and, in one movement, press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders as you go down into the next squat.

Dumbbell_Toe_Touch.name: Dumbbell Toe Touch
steps: Lie on your back with your legs pointing up, holding a dumbbell straight over your chest.
Reach the dumbbell up towards your toes, lifting your shoulders off the floor.
Lower with control.
Keep your legs still.

Dumbbell_Triceps_Kickback_Two-Arm.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback, Two-Arm
steps: Hinge forward holding a dumbbell in each hand, upper arms at your sides and elbows bent.
Straighten both arms back.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_V-Up.name: Dumbbell V-Up
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and a light dumbbell held overhead.
Lift your legs and torso and reach the dumbbell to your feet.
Lower both ends back down.
Keep your arms straight.

Dumbbell_W_Raise.name: Dumbbell W Raise
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells, elbows bent.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades, arms in a W shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Walking_Lunge.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Take a long step forward and lower until your front thigh is level and your back knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot and bring your back leg through into the next step.
Keep your torso upright as you walk.

Dumbbell_Windmill.name: Dumbbell Windmill
steps: Press a dumbbell overhead in one hand, feet wider than shoulders, toes turned away from that arm.
Push your hips out to the side and lower your free hand down your leg towards the floor.
Keep your eyes on the dumbbell and your arm straight.
Return upright; finish the set and switch sides.

Dumbbell_Woodchop.name: Dumbbell Woodchop
steps: Stand holding one dumbbell with both hands by one hip.
Swing it diagonally up and across your body to above the opposite shoulder, pivoting your feet.
Bring it back down with control.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Dumbbell_Wrist_Curl.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your forearms on your thighs, holding dumbbells underhand past your knees.
Let your wrists bend back.
Curl your wrists up as far as you can.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Y_Raise.name: Dumbbell Y Raise
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells, arms hanging.
Raise your arms up and forward in a Y shape, thumbs up.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Dumbbell_Z_Press.name: Dumbbell Z Press
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you, holding a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Sit tall without leaning back.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders.

EZ-Bar_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled parts, arms straight.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back or swing.

EZ-Bar_Drag_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Drag Curl
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar underhand at your thighs.
Pull your elbows back as you curl, dragging the bar up along your body.
Stop when the bar reaches your lower chest.
Lower it along the same path.

EZ-Bar_Front_Raise.name: EZ-Bar Front Raise
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar overhand at your thighs.
Lift it forward and up, arms nearly straight, to eye level.
Lower with control.
Don't swing your body.

EZ-Bar_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.name: EZ-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand or sit holding an EZ bar overhead on the inner angled grips.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
Keep your upper arms pointing up.
Straighten your arms back to the top.

EZ-Bar_Preacher_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar underhand.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.

EZ-Bar_Pullover.name: EZ-Bar Pullover
steps: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar over your chest on the inner grips.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the bar back over your head.
Stop when your arms are in line with your body.
Pull it back over your chest.

EZ-Bar_Reverse_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Reverse Curl
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip on the angled parts.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders, elbows at your sides.
Keep your wrists straight.
Lower with control.

EZ-Bar_Reverse_Preacher_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Reverse Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, wrists straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.

EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar above your chest with an overhand grip on the inner angled parts.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Stop just above your forehead, then straighten your arms to press the bar back up.
Keep your elbows pointing up and in, not out to the sides.
Move slowly near your head, and use a weight you can control.

EZ-Bar_Upright_Row.name: EZ-Bar Upright Row
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar overhand at your thighs, hands on the angled parts.
Pull it up along your body until it is just below your chin, elbows high.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

EZ-Bar_Wrist_Curl.name: EZ-Bar Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar underhand.
Let your wrists bend back so the bar hangs past your knees.
Curl your wrists up as far as you can.
Lower with control.

Elevated_Cable_Rows.name: Elevated Cable Row
steps: Place a low platform or step on the seat of a low-pulley row station and sit on it, feet braced and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with straight arms, letting your shoulders reach forward for a stretch.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let it return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back straight and your upper body still; don't rock back to move the weight.

External_Rotation_with_Cable.name: Cable External Rotation
steps: Set a pulley at about elbow height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle in the hand farther from the machine.
Keep that elbow bent at a right angle and tucked against your side, forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm out, away from your body, as far as you comfortably can while keeping your elbow at your side.
Return slowly to the start, then switch sides after the set.
Use a light weight and move slowly; your upper arm shouldn't move.

Face_Pull.name: Face Pull
steps: Attach a rope to a pulley set at about face height and hold the ends with your palms facing in.
Step back until your arms are straight and the cable is taut, standing tall.
Pull the rope towards your face, separating the ends and bringing your elbows out and back, level with your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and don't lean back to pull.

Farmers_Walk.name: Farmer's Walk
steps: Place a heavy dumbbell, kettlebell or farmer's handle beside each foot.
Squat down with a flat back, grip the handles firmly and stand up tall.
Walk forward with short, steady steps, arms straight at your sides.
Stop after the distance or time you've set and set the weights down by squatting, not bending your back.
Keep your shoulders back and your stomach braced; don't let the weights swing.

Flat_Bench_Lying_Leg_Raise.name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back on a flat bench and hold the sides of the bench behind your head.
Straighten your legs out in line with the bench, with your knees slightly soft.
Raise your legs until they point straight up, keeping them together.
Lower them slowly until they're level with the bench, without letting them drop.
Keep your lower back pressed into the bench; bend your knees more if it lifts.

Floor_Glute-Ham_Raise.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
steps: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down, body straight from knees to head.
Lower your body forward with your hips extended until you are almost parallel to the floor.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings, keeping your hips straight.
Use your hands to help if you can't make it back up.

Flutter_Kicks.name: Flutter Kicks
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Lift your heels a few centimetres off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating movements.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

Forward_Lunge.name: Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee over your foot and your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to step back to the start, then switch legs.

Frog_Pump.name: Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back, bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall out to the sides.
Pull your heels in close to your buttocks.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control and repeat.

Front_Barbell_Squat.name: Barbell Front Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and step under it so it sits on the front of your shoulders, close to your throat.
Hold the bar with your fingertips just outside your shoulders and lift your elbows high, upper arms about level with the floor.
Step back, stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and squat down, keeping your chest up and elbows high.
Go until your thighs are at least level with the floor, then push through your whole foot to stand up.
Keep your elbows up throughout so the bar stays on your shoulders; if they drop, the bar rolls forward.

Front_Dumbbell_Raise.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
With your arms nearly straight, raise one or both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to your thighs.
Keep your upper body still and don't swing the weights up.

Front_Squats_With_Two_Kettlebells.name: Double Kettlebell Front Squat
steps: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, handles in your palms and the bells against your forearms, elbows tucked in.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat as deep as you can with your chest up.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows close to your body and your back straight throughout.

Glute_Bridge_March.name: Glute Bridge March
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, then lift your hips into a bridge.
Lift one foot off the floor and bring the knee towards your chest.
Put it down and lift the other foot.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.

Glute_Ham_Raise.name: Glute Ham Raise
steps: Adjust the glute ham bench so your knees are just behind the pad and your feet are secured against the foot plate.
Start with your body upright on your knees, straight from knees to head.
Lower your upper body forward slowly by straightening your knees, keeping your hips straight.
Pull yourself back up by pressing your toes into the plate and bending your knees.
Keep your glutes squeezed so your hips don't bend; use your hands to help at first if needed.

Goblet_Squat.name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the handle, or a dumbbell by one end, close to your chest with your elbows pointing down.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Squat down between your legs, keeping your chest up, until your elbows are near the inside of your knees.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep the weight close to your chest and your heels on the floor.

Good_Morning.name: Good Morning
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Brace your stomach and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back to lean forward until your upper body is nearly level with the floor, or until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your upper body back to standing.
Keep your back flat throughout and start with a light weight.

Gorilla_Row.name: Gorilla Row
steps: Stand wide with two kettlebells on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Grip both bells, back flat.
Row one bell up while pushing the other into the floor.
Lower it and row the other.

Guillotine_Press.name: Guillotine Press
steps: Lie on the bench and grip the bar wider than for a normal bench press.
Lower the bar towards your upper chest or neck, elbows flared.
Press it back up to straight arms.
Use light weight and a spotter.

Hack_Squat.name: Hack Squat
steps: Stand on the hack squat platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform and release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower yourself until your thighs are about level with the platform.
Push through your whole foot to straighten your legs, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Keep your back against the pad and your knees in line with your toes.

Half-Kneeling_Landmine_Rotation.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Rotation
steps: Kneel on one knee holding the end of a landmine barbell in front of your chest with both arms extended.
Rotate the bar down towards the outside of one hip.
Bring it back up and across to the other side.
Keep your hips still and your arms straight.

Half-Kneeling_Pallof_Press.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
steps: Kneel on one knee side-on to a pulley at chest height, holding the handle at your chest.
Press it straight out.
Resist the pull towards the pulley.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Hammer_Curls.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up, palms still facing in.
Squeeze at the top, then lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't swing your body.

Hammer_Grip_Incline_DB_Bench_Press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press, Neutral Grip
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your palms facing each other and your shoulder blades against the bench throughout.

Handstand_Push-Ups.name: Handstand Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, about a hand's length from a wall.
Kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall and your arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your head slowly towards the floor, with your head slightly in front of your hands.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Only try this once you can hold a handstand against a wall comfortably; put a folded mat under your head.

Hang_Clean.name: Hang Clean
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip just outside your legs.
Push your hips back and bend your knees slightly so the bar lowers to just above your knees, back flat.
Jump the bar up fast by straightening your hips and knees, shrugging and pulling your elbows up.
Drop under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows forward, then stand up.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout, and learn the lift with a light bar first.

Hang_Power_Clean.name: Hang Power Clean
steps: Stand with a barbell at your hips, grip just outside your legs.
Push your hips back to lower the bar to just above the knees.
Jump explosively, shrug and catch the bar on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand up with the bar in the front rack.

Hang_Power_Snatch.name: Hang Power Snatch
steps: Stand with a barbell in a wide snatch grip at your hips.
Push your hips back to lower the bar to just above the knees.
Jump explosively, shrug and pull the bar up, catching it overhead in a quarter squat.
Stand up with the bar locked out overhead.

Hang_Snatch.name: Hang Snatch
steps: Stand with a barbell in a wide snatch grip at your hips.
Push your hips back to lower the bar to just above the knees.
Jump explosively, shrug, and pull yourself under the bar into an overhead squat.
Stand up with the bar locked out overhead.

Hanging_Knee_Raise.name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and straight arms.
Bring your knees up towards your chest, curling your hips up.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging; pause at the bottom if you need to.

Hanging_Leg_Raise.name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart and your legs straight.
Brace your stomach and keep your body still.
Raise your legs until your thighs are at least level with the floor, bending your knees if you need to.
Lower them slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging; pause at the bottom if you start to sway.

High_Knees.name: High Knees
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms as you would when sprinting.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep a fast rhythm.

Hollow_Hold.name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs a few centimetres off it.
Hold this shallow banana shape, keeping your lower back down.
Bend your knees or bring your arms in if your back lifts.

Hollow_Rock.name: Hollow Rock
steps: Lie on your back and lift into a hollow hold, arms overhead and legs straight.
Rock back towards your shoulders, then forward towards your hips.
Keep the same shape throughout; the movement comes from the rock, not from bending.
Stop when you can't keep your lower back rounded.

Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.name: Back Extension
steps: Set the back extension bench so the top of the pad sits just below your hips, then lock your heels under the foot pads.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper body hang down, back straight.
Raise your upper body until it's in line with your legs.
Lower it slowly back down.
Stop when your body is straight; don't arch your back beyond that.

Incline_Barbell_Bench_Press_Close_Grip.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press, Close Grip
steps: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack it and lower it to your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up to straight arms.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together.

Incline_Bench_Pull.name: Incline Barbell Row
steps: Set an incline bench to a low angle and lie face down on it with a barbell on the floor below you.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, arms hanging straight.
Pull the bar up towards the bench, bringing your elbows up and back.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the bench throughout.

Incline_Cable_Curl.name: Incline Cable Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench between two low pulleys, holding a handle in each hand.
Curl the handles up, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

Incline_Cable_Flye.name: Incline Cable Fly
steps: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand as you lie back.
Start with your arms above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring your hands back together above your chest along the same arc.
Keep the bend in your elbows the same throughout.

Incline_Cable_Press.name: Incline Cable Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench between two low pulleys, a handle in each hand at your chest.
Press the handles up and together.
Lower with control.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together.

Incline_Dumbbell_Curl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Turn your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders without moving your upper arms forward.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight again.
Keep your back and head against the bench throughout.

Incline_Dumbbell_Fly_Hammer_Grip.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly, Hammer Grip
steps: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Open your arms out to the sides, keeping your palms facing in and elbows slightly bent.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together.

Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
Don't lower the dumbbells below the level of your shoulders.

Incline_Dumbbell_Lateral_Raise.name: Incline Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Lie on your side on an incline bench, holding a dumbbell in your top hand.
Raise the dumbbell up and out until your arm points to the ceiling.
Lower slowly.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Incline_Dumbbell_Press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and sit with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back, bringing the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, then press them up above your upper chest.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your upper chest, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet flat and your back and shoulder blades against the bench.

Incline_Dumbbell_Reverse_Fly.name: Incline Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells, arms hanging.
Raise your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the top.
Lower with control.

Incline_Dumbbell_Row_One-Arm.name: Incline Dumbbell Row, One-Arm
steps: Lie face down on a low incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell up towards your hip.
Pause at the top.
Lower, finish the set and switch sides.

Incline_Hammer_Curl.name: Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower until your arms are straight.

Incline_Push-Up.name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on a bench, box or sturdy raised surface, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the surface.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your stomach and glutes tight so your hips don't sag.

Inverted_Row.name: Inverted Row
steps: Set a bar in a rack or Smith machine at about waist height and lie underneath it.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, arms straight and heels on the floor.
Keep your body straight from head to heels and pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up; bend your knees to make it easier or raise the bar.

JM_Press.name: JM Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and let the bar come down and slightly towards your head, keeping your elbows pointing towards your feet.
Lower it until the bar is just above your upper chest or chin, with your forearms nearly upright.
Push the bar back up by straightening your elbows.
Use a moderate weight and move slowly; it's a mix of a close-grip bench press and a skullcrusher.

Jump_Squat.name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, hands in front of your chest.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up and jump as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next squat.

Jumping_Jack.name: Jumping Jack
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wider than your shoulders while swinging your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start, bringing your arms down to your sides.
Keep a steady rhythm and land softly on the balls of your feet.

Kettlebell_Arm_Bar.name: Kettlebell Arm Bar
steps: Lie on your back and press a kettlebell up in one hand.
Bend the same-side knee and roll onto your opposite side, keeping the arm vertical.
Hold, letting your shoulder settle, eyes on the bell.
Roll back and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Around_the_World.name: Kettlebell Around the World
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Pass it around your body from hand to hand.
Keep your hips still and your core braced.
Switch direction halfway through.

Kettlebell_Bent-Over_Row.name: Kettlebell Bent-Over Row
steps: Hinge forward holding a kettlebell in each hand, back flat.
Row both bells up towards your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_Bottoms-Up_Carry.name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Carry
steps: Hold a kettlebell upside down at your shoulder, bottom up.
Squeeze the handle hard to keep it balanced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Switch hands and walk back.

Kettlebell_Bottoms-Up_Press.name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Press
steps: Hold a kettlebell upside down at your shoulder, bottom pointing to the ceiling.
Squeeze the handle hard to keep the bell balanced.
Press it overhead without letting it tip.
Lower it back to your shoulder; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Calf_Raise.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

Kettlebell_Clean.name: Kettlebell Clean
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Hike it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body, rotating it onto your forearm in the rack.
Lower it back between your legs; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Clean_and_Press.name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
steps: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and clean it into the rack position.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to the rack, then let it swing back between your legs.
Go into the next rep; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Cossack_Squat.name: Kettlebell Cossack Squat
steps: Stand wide holding a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Squat over one leg, keeping the other straight with its toes up.
Push back to the middle.
Repeat on the other side.

Kettlebell_Curl.name: Kettlebell Curl
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle in each hand, or one by the horns.
Curl it up towards your shoulders, elbows at your sides.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_Dead_Bug.name: Kettlebell Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest with both hands, knees bent above your hips.
Extend one leg towards the floor.
Bring it back and extend the other.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

Kettlebell_Dead_Clean.name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Stand up explosively from the floor without swinging the bell back.
Pull it up close to your body into the rack position.
Lower it to the floor; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Deadlift.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge and grip the handle with both hands, back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand up tall.
Lower it back to the floor with control.

Kettlebell_Farmers_Walk.name: Kettlebell Farmer's Walk
steps: Hold a heavy kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Set the bells down with a flat back.

Kettlebell_Figure_Eight.name: Kettlebell Figure Eight
steps: Stand with your feet wide and hinge forward holding a kettlebell.
Pass it between your legs from one hand to the other, around one leg.
Bring it around the other leg in a figure eight.
Keep your back flat throughout.

Kettlebell_Floor_Press.name: Kettlebell Floor Press
steps: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in each hand in the rack position, upper arms on the floor.
Press the bells up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Keep your wrists straight.

Kettlebell_Front_Raise.name: Kettlebell Front Raise
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it forward to shoulder height, arms nearly straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_Front_Squat_One-Arm.name: Kettlebell Front Squat, One-Arm
steps: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel without leaning to the side.
Drive back up.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Goblet_Curtsy_Lunge.name: Kettlebell Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

Kettlebell_Goblet_Lunge.name: Kettlebell Goblet Lunge
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs, or finish the set and switch.

Kettlebell_Goblet_Reverse_Lunge.name: Kettlebell Goblet Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs, or finish the set and switch.

Kettlebell_Good_Morning.name: Kettlebell Good Morning
steps: Hold a kettlebell against your upper chest with both hands.
Push your hips back and lower your torso towards level, knees slightly bent.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Kettlebell_Halo.name: Kettlebell Halo
steps: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns at chest height.
Circle it around your head, close to your neck.
Bring it back to the front and go the other way.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.

Kettlebell_Hammer_Curl.name: Kettlebell Hammer Curl
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle in each hand, palms facing in.
Curl the bells up towards your shoulders.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_High_Pull.name: Kettlebell High Pull
steps: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Hike it back, then drive your hips forward.
Pull the bell up to chest height with your elbow high.
Let it drop back down; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Hip_Thrust.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a kettlebell on your hips.
Plant your feet and hold the bell in place.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knee to shoulder.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_Jerk.name: Kettlebell Jerk
steps: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder.
Dip and drive up with your legs to launch the bell.
Dip again under it, locking your arm out overhead.
Stand up, then lower the bell back to the rack.

Kettlebell_Lateral_Raise.name: Kettlebell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand holding a light kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift.name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a kettlebell in the hand opposite your standing leg.
Push your hips back and lean forward, letting your free leg rise straight behind you.
Lower the kettlebell towards the floor until your upper body is nearly level with the floor, or as far as your balance allows.
Squeeze the glute of your standing leg to return to standing.
Keep your hips level and your back flat throughout.

Kettlebell_Overhead_Carry.name: Kettlebell Overhead Carry
steps: Press one or two kettlebells overhead and lock your arms.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Lower the bells, switching hands if carrying one.

Kettlebell_Overhead_Lunge.name: Kettlebell Overhead Lunge
steps: Press a kettlebell overhead in one hand and lock your arm.
Step forward or back into a lunge, keeping the bell overhead.
Push back to the start.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Overhead_Squat.name: Kettlebell Overhead Squat
steps: Press a kettlebell overhead in one hand and lock your arm.
Squat down as low as you can, keeping the bell over your head.
Drive back up.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.
Keep your upper arms pointing up.
Straighten your arms back to the top.

Kettlebell_Pistol_Squat.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Extend the other leg forward.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can.
Drive back up; finish the set and switch legs.

Kettlebell_Press.name: Kettlebell Press
steps: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to the rack; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Pullover.name: Kettlebell Pullover
steps: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell by the horns over your chest.
Lower it back over your head with your elbows slightly bent.
Stop when your arms are in line with your body.
Pull it back over your chest.

Kettlebell_Push_Press.name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder.
Dip at your knees, then drive up with your legs.
Use that drive to press the bell overhead.
Lower it back to the rack; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Rack_Carry.name: Kettlebell Rack Carry
steps: Clean one or two kettlebells into the rack position.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Lower the bells when you finish.

Kettlebell_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand or one by the horns at your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the bell along your legs, knees slightly bent.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Kettlebell_Row_Staggered_Stance.name: Kettlebell Row, Staggered Stance
steps: Stand in a staggered stance and hinge forward, resting one forearm on your front thigh.
Hold a kettlebell in the other hand.
Row it up towards your hip.
Lower; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Russian_Twist.name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet if you can.
Rotate to tap the bell beside one hip, then the other.
Keep your back straight.

Kettlebell_Shrug.name: Kettlebell Shrug
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_Sit-Up.name: Kettlebell Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit all the way up.
Lower back down with control.
Hook your feet under something if you need to.

Kettlebell_Skull_Crusher.name: Kettlebell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell by the horns over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower it towards your forehead.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms back up.

Kettlebell_Snatch.name: Kettlebell Snatch
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Hike it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up, punching your hand through to lock it overhead.
Bring it back down between your legs; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Step-Up.name: Kettlebell Step-Up
steps: Stand facing a box holding a kettlebell in each hand or one at your chest.
Step up with one foot and drive through it to stand on the box.
Step down with control.
Alternate legs, or finish the set and switch.

Kettlebell_Suitcase_Carry.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Carry
steps: Hold one kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Stand tall with your shoulders level.
Walk forward without leaning towards the bell.
Switch hands and walk back.

Kettlebell_Suitcase_Deadlift.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor beside one foot.
Hinge and squat down to grip it, shoulders level.
Stand up without leaning towards the bell.
Lower it; finish the set and switch sides.

Kettlebell_Sumo_Deadlift.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet wide, toes out, and a kettlebell between them.
Squat down and grip the handle with both hands, chest up.
Stand up tall.
Lower it back to the floor with control.

Kettlebell_Sumo_High_Pull.name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
steps: Stand with your feet wide and a kettlebell on the floor between them.
Squat down and grip the handle with both hands.
Stand up explosively and pull the bell to your chin, elbows high.
Lower it back to the floor.

Kettlebell_Swing.name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your hips and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge and grip the handle with both hands, then hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell to chest height, arms straight.
Let it fall back between your legs and go into the next rep.

Kettlebell_Thruster.name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows tucked in, and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push up out of the squat and use that drive to press the kettlebells overhead in one movement.
Lower the kettlebells back to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.
Keep your elbows up in the squat and your stomach braced during the press.

Kettlebell_Turkish_Get-Up_Squat_style.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
steps: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight above one shoulder, with the knee on that side bent and the foot flat.
Roll onto the opposite elbow and then that hand, keeping the kettlebell straight above you.
Lift your hips, bring both feet under you into a deep squat, then stand up with the kettlebell overhead.
Reverse each step slowly to return to lying on the floor, then switch sides.
Keep your arm straight and your eyes on the kettlebell until you're standing.

Kettlebell_Upright_Row.name: Kettlebell Upright Row
steps: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands at your thighs.
Pull it up to your chest, elbows high.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Kettlebell_Windmill.name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Hold a kettlebell straight above one shoulder and stand with your feet wider than your hips, both toes turned away from the kettlebell side.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and push your hips out towards the side holding it.
Lean down towards your other foot, sliding your free hand down that leg, until your upper body is close to level with the floor.
Rise back up the same way, keeping the kettlebell arm straight, then switch sides after the set.
Keep both legs nearly straight and move slowly.

Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars.name: Parallel Bar Knee Raise
steps: Hold yourself up on parallel bars or a leg raise station with your arms straight or forearms on the pads, legs hanging.
Brace your stomach and keep your back against the pad if there is one.
Bend your knees and raise them towards your chest, curling your hips up slightly.
Lower your legs slowly until they're straight again.
Avoid swinging your legs to get them up.

Knee_Push-Up.name: Knee Push-Up
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body forms a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

Kneeling_Cable_Pullover.name: Kneeling Cable Pullover
steps: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a straight bar with straight arms.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs, arms straight.
Squeeze your lats.
Return with control.

Kneeling_Dumbbell_Row.name: Kneeling Dumbbell Row
steps: Kneel on a bench on both knees with one hand on the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm straight.
Row it up to your hip.
Lower, finish the set and switch sides.

Knees_to_Elbows.name: Knees to Elbows
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your knees up until they touch your elbows.
Lower your legs with control.
Keep the swing small.

Kroc_Row.name: Kroc Row
steps: Brace one hand on a bench and hold a heavy dumbbell in the other.
Keep your back flat at about 30 degrees from horizontal.
Row the dumbbell up to your hip, letting your body move a little.
Lower fully; finish the set and switch sides.

Landmine_Anti-Rotation_Press.name: Landmine Anti-Rotation Press
steps: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest with both hands, standing side-on to the anchor.
Press the bar straight out in front of you.
Resist the pull to rotate towards the anchor.
Bring it back to your chest; finish the set and switch sides.

Landmine_Deadlift.name: Landmine Deadlift
steps: Stand facing the end of a landmine barbell, or straddling it.
Squat down and grip the end with both hands, back flat.
Stand up, driving through your feet.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

Landmine_Lateral_Raise.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a landmine barbell and hold the end in your far hand, low in front of your hips.
Raise it up and out to the side until your arm is at shoulder height.
Lower with control.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Landmine_Press.name: Landmine Press
steps: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest with both hands, standing in a split stance.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.

Landmine_Press_One-Arm.name: Landmine Press, One-Arm
steps: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your shoulder in one hand.
Stand in a split stance with the opposite foot forward.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control, finish the set and switch sides.

Landmine_Reverse_Lunge.name: Landmine Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest with both hands.
Step back with one leg and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs, or finish the set and switch.

Landmine_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand facing the end of a landmine barbell and hold it at your hips with both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs, knees slightly bent.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Landmine_Row_One-Arm.name: Landmine Row, One-Arm
steps: Stand beside the end of a landmine barbell and hinge forward, one hand on your knee.
Grip the bar end with the other hand.
Row it towards your hip, keeping your back flat.
Lower with control, finish the set and switch sides.

Landmine_Squat.name: Landmine Squat
steps: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel, keeping your chest up.
Drive back up to standing.

Landmine_Sumo_Squat.name: Landmine Sumo Squat
steps: Straddle the end of a landmine barbell with your feet wide, toes out.
Squat down and grip the bar end with both hands.
Stand up, holding the bar between your legs with straight arms.
Lower with control.

Landmine_Thruster.name: Landmine Thruster
steps: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up and use the momentum to press the bar up and forward.
Lower the bar to your chest as you go into the next squat.

Larsen_Press.name: Larsen Press
steps: Lie on the bench with your legs straight out in front, feet off the floor.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your chest.
Press it back up without arching your back.
Keep your legs still throughout.

Lat_Pulldown_Behind_the_Neck.name: Lat Pulldown, Behind the Neck
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown station holding the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean your head slightly forward.
Pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Return with control; use a light weight.

Lat_Pulldown_Neutral_Grip.name: Lat Pulldown, Neutral Grip
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown station holding a neutral-grip bar, palms facing each other.
Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return with control.

Lat_Pulldown_Rope.name: Lat Pulldown, Rope
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown station holding the rope ends.
Pull the rope down towards your upper chest, spreading the ends.
Drive your elbows down.
Return with control.

Lat_Pulldown_Wide_Underhand.name: Lat Pulldown, Wide Underhand
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown station holding the bar underhand, wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down.
Return with control.

Lateral_Box_Jump.name: Lateral Box Jump
steps: Stand side-on next to a box.
Bend your knees and jump sideways onto the box.
Land softly on both feet, then stand tall.
Step down and repeat on the other side.

Lateral_Raise_-_With_Bands.name: Band Lateral Raise
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand at your sides.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise your arms out to the sides until your hands are at shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower them slowly.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

Leaning_Dumbbell_Lateral_Raise.name: Leaning Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Hold a support with one hand and lean away from it, holding a dumbbell in the other hand.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm is level with the floor.
Lower slowly.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Leg_Extensions.name: Leg Extension
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot point and the pad sits on your lower shins.
Sit back against the pad and hold the handles at your sides.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad until your knees are straight.
Pause briefly, then lower the pad slowly.
Keep your hips on the seat and don't kick the weight up.

Leg_Press.name: Leg Press
steps: Sit in the leg press with your back against the pad and your feet about shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Press the platform up until your legs are nearly straight, then release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly until your knees are at about a right angle.
Push through your whole foot to press the platform back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Keep your lower back and hips against the pad; don't lower so far that your hips lift.

Leg_Raise_with_Hip_Lift.name: Leg Raise with Hip Lift
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides and your legs straight.
Raise your legs until they point at the ceiling.
Press your hands down and lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet upward.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.

Leverage_Chest_Press.name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at the middle of your chest, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent and slightly below your shoulders.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your back and shoulder blades against the pad.

Leverage_High_Row.name: Machine High Row
steps: Adjust the seat so you can just reach the handles with straight arms, then sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles, which are above and in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back towards your chest, bringing your elbows down past your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest against the pad and don't lean back to pull.

Leverage_Iso_Row.name: Machine Row
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at about chest height, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles with your arms straight.
Pull the handles back towards your ribs, one at a time or together, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest against the pad throughout.

Low_Cable_Crossover.name: Low Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys low, hold a handle in each hand and step forward to the middle, one foot ahead of the other.
Start with your arms down and out to the sides, elbows slightly bent and palms facing forward.
Raise your hands up and together in front of your upper chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest, then let your arms return slowly along the same arc.
Keep the bend in your elbows the same and your upper body still.

Lying_Cable_Pullover.name: Lying Cable Pullover
steps: Lie on a bench with your head towards a low pulley, holding a bar over your head.
Pull the bar over your chest in an arc, arms nearly straight.
Lower it back over your head with control.
Keep your elbow bend fixed.

Lying_Cable_Triceps_Extension.name: Lying Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a bench with your head towards a low pulley, holding a bar above your face.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms back up.

Lying_Dumbbell_Reverse_Fly.name: Lying Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Lie face down on a flat bench holding light dumbbells, arms hanging.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Lying_Dumbbell_Tricep_Extension.name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Stop when your forearms are just past level with the bench, then straighten your arms to lift them back up.
Keep your elbows pointing up and in, not out to the sides.
Move slowly near your head, and use a weight you can control.

Lying_Leg_Curls.name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot point, then lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed into the bench.
Curl your heels towards your glutes as far as you can.
Pause briefly, then lower the pad slowly until your legs are straight.
Keep your hips down; if they lift, use a lighter weight.

Lying_Triceps_Press.name: Lying Triceps Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold an EZ bar above your chest with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart or closer.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Stop just before the bar reaches your head, then straighten your arms to press it back up.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close together throughout.
Move slowly near your head, and use a weight you can control.

Machine_Bench_Press.name: Machine Bench Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest, then lie or sit back against the pad.
Hold the handles slightly wider than your shoulders with your elbows bent.
Press the handles away from you until your arms are straight.
Let them return slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your back and shoulder blades against the pad throughout.

Machine_Bicep_Curl.name: Machine Biceps Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms lie flat on the pad and your elbows line up with the machine's pivot point.
Hold the handles with an underhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Curl the handles up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and don't lift your body off the seat.

Machine_Lateral_Raise.name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Sit in the lateral raise machine with the pads on the outside of your arms.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Machine_Shoulder_Military_Press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at about shoulder height, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with your palms facing forward.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad and don't arch your lower back.

Machine_Shrug.name: Machine Shrug
steps: Stand or sit in the shrug machine holding the handles.
Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.

Machine_Triceps_Extension.name: Machine Triceps Extension
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot point and your upper arms lie on the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent.
Straighten your arms to push the handles down or forward until your elbows are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows are bent again.
Keep your upper arms on the pad; only your forearms should move.

Man_Maker.name: Man Maker
steps: Start in a push-up position holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Do a push-up, then row each dumbbell once.
Jump your feet in and clean the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Squat and press them overhead, then lower them to the floor.

Meadows_Row.name: Meadows Row
steps: Stand side-on to the end of a landmine barbell in a staggered stance and grip the sleeve overhand.
Rest your other forearm on your front knee.
Row the bar up, driving your elbow high and back.
Lower with control, finish the set and switch sides.

Medicine_Ball_Chest_Pass.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
steps: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Throw it into the wall as hard as you can, straightening your arms.
Catch it on the rebound.
Reset and repeat.

Medicine_Ball_Rotational_Throw.name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
steps: Stand side-on to a wall holding a medicine ball at your far hip.
Rotate your hips and throw the ball sideways into the wall.
Catch it on the rebound and reset.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Medicine_Ball_Slam.name: Medicine Ball Slam
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a slam ball overhead.
Slam it into the floor in front of you as hard as you can, hinging at the hips.
Squat down and pick it up.
Lift it overhead and go into the next slam.

Monster_Walk.name: Monster Walk
steps: Place a resistance band around your legs, just above your knees or around your ankles.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart so the band is taut, then bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step forward and out to the side with one foot, then with the other, walking forward in a wide stance.
Walk for the distance you've set, then walk backwards the same way.
Keep tension on the band throughout and don't let your knees fall inwards.

Mountain_Climbers.name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Bring one knee towards your chest.
Switch legs quickly, sending that foot back as you bring the other knee in.
Keep switching at a steady pace for the time you've set.
Keep your hips low and your shoulders above your hands.

Muscle_Snatch.name: Muscle Snatch
steps: Stand with a barbell in a wide snatch grip at your hips or start from the floor.
Extend your hips and knees explosively, pulling the bar up close to your body.
Turn your elbows over and press the bar up to lockout without bending your knees again.
Lower the bar with control.

Narrow_Stance_Leg_Press.name: Leg Press, Narrow Stance
steps: Sit in the leg press and place your feet close together, less than hip-width apart, in the middle of the platform.
Press the platform up and release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly as far as you can while keeping your hips on the pad.
Push through your whole foot to press the platform back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Keep your knees pointing the same way as your toes.

Nordic_Hamstring_Curl.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Kneel on a pad with a partner holding your ankles, or with your heels hooked under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your body forward as slowly as you can, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push back up to the start.

One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one knee and the same hand on a flat bench, with the other foot on the floor and your back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand with your arm hanging straight down.
Pull the dumbbell up to the side of your ribs, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your back flat and your shoulders level; don't twist to lift the weight.

One-Arm_Kettlebell_Row.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row
steps: Place a kettlebell on the floor and stand in a staggered stance, one hand on your front thigh or a bench.
Lean forward with your back flat and hold the kettlebell in your other hand, arm straight.
Pull the kettlebell up to the side of your ribs, elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your shoulders level and don't twist your upper body.

One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and a kettlebell on the floor just in front of you.
Push your hips back, grab the handle with one hand and swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward sharply to swing the kettlebell up to about chest height, arm straight.
Let it swing back down between your legs as you push your hips back, then repeat, switching hands after the set.
The power comes from your hips, not your arm; keep your back flat.

One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and fasten it around one ankle.
Face the machine, hold it for support and lean forward slightly.
Kick the strapped leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Return it slowly to the start, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your back flat and don't swing the leg higher by arching your lower back.

One_Arm_Lat_Pulldown.name: One-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and sit or kneel facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, arm straight above you.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, bringing your elbow down towards your hip.
Let it rise slowly until your arm is straight, then switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper body still and don't twist to pull the handle.

Overhead_Cable_Curl.name: Overhead Cable Curl
steps: Set two pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding a handle in each hand with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your palms to face up.
Curl the handles in towards the sides of your head, keeping your upper arms level with the floor.
Squeeze your biceps, then straighten your arms slowly.
Keep your upper arms still; only your forearms should move.

Overhead_Squat.name: Overhead Squat
steps: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip, arms straight.
Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips, toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you can, keeping your torso upright and the bar over your mid-foot.
Stand back up with the bar still overhead.

Pallof_Press.name: Pallof Press
steps: Set a pulley at about chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with both hands at the middle of your chest.
Step away until the cable is taut and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Press the handle straight out in front of you until your arms are straight, resisting the pull to rotate.
Hold briefly, then bring the handle back to your chest, and switch sides after the set.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward throughout.

Pallof_Walkout.name: Pallof Walkout
steps: Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height, holding the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press it out, then step sideways away from the pulley.
Step back in.
Finish the set and switch sides.

Palms-Down_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a flat bench and place your forearms on it, hands hanging over the edge.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing down, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar by bending your wrists upwards as far as you can.
Lower it slowly as far as is comfortable.
Keep your forearms on the bench; only your hands should move.

Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a flat bench and place your forearms on it, hands hanging over the edge.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing up, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar lower slowly by bending your wrists down.
Curl your wrists up to lift the bar as high as you can.
Keep your forearms on the bench; only your hands should move.

Pendlay_Row.name: Pendlay Row
steps: Stand over a barbell on the floor, knees slightly bent, torso level with the floor, back flat.
Grip the bar overhand, a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest without raising your torso.
Lower the bar back to the floor and let it settle before the next rep.

Pike_Push-Up.name: Pike Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips high.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head towards the floor between your hands.
Keep your hips high and your legs as straight as you can.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

Pin_Squat.name: Pin Squat
steps: Set the safety pins in a rack at the height of your lowest squat position.
Unrack the bar onto your back and squat down until the bar rests on the pins.
Pause there for a moment without relaxing.
Drive the bar up off the pins to standing.

Pistol_Squat.name: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front of you.
Reach your arms forward and squat down on the standing leg as low as you can.
Keep your heel flat and the free leg off the floor.
Drive back up to standing, then finish the set and switch legs.

Plank.name: Plank
steps: Place your forearms on the floor with your elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for the time you've set, breathing steadily.
Don't let your hips sag or lift; stop when you can't keep the line.

Plank_Jack.name: Plank Jack
steps: Start in a push-up position with your feet together.
Jump your feet out wide, then jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and your arms straight.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm.

Plank_Reach.name: Plank Reach
steps: Start in a push-up position with your feet a little apart.
Lift one arm and reach it straight forward, level with your body.
Hold for a moment, then put the hand back down.
Alternate arms without letting your hips twist.

Plank_Shoulder_Tap.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
steps: Start in a push-up position with your feet a little wider than hip-width.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Put the hand back down and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips level; don't let them rock side to side.

Power_Clean.name: Power Clean
steps: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, grip it just outside your legs and set a flat back with your hips above your knees.
Push through your legs to lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Jump the bar up fast by straightening your hips and knees, shrugging and pulling your elbows up.
Drop slightly under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows forward, then stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout, and learn the lift with a light bar first.

Power_Shrug.name: Power Shrug
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Dip slightly at the knees and hips.
Drive up and shrug your shoulders up as high as you can.
Lower the bar with control.

Power_Snatch.name: Power Snatch
steps: Set up over a barbell on the floor with a wide snatch grip, hips low, back flat, arms straight.
Lift the bar off the floor, then extend your hips and knees explosively as it passes your thighs.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it locked out overhead in a quarter squat.
Stand up tall with the bar overhead, then lower it.

Preacher_Curl.name: Barbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, squeezing your biceps.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and control the bar at the bottom.

Prone_Incline_Dumbbell_Curl.name: Prone Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Lie face down on a steep incline bench holding dumbbells underhand, arms hanging.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your chest on the pad.
Lower with control.

Prone_T_Raise.name: Prone T Raise
steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T shape, thumbs pointing up.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your head in line with your spine.

Prone_Y_Raise.name: Prone Y Raise
steps: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades back and down.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your head in line with your spine.

Pull-Up_Neutral_Grip.name: Pull-Up, Neutral Grip
steps: Grip the parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with straight arms.
Pull until your chin is above the handles.
Lower with control to a full hang.

Pull_Through.name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut, feet a little wider than your hips.
Push your hips back and let the rope pull your hands between your legs, knees slightly bent and back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips forward and stand up tall.
Your arms only hold the rope; the movement comes from your hips.

Pullups.name: Pull-Up
steps: Hold a pull-up bar with your palms facing away, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms straight and your stomach braced.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar, bringing your elbows down towards your ribs.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Avoid swinging or kicking your legs to get up.

Pulse_Squat.name: Pulse Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Rise a few centimetres, then sink back to the bottom position.
Keep pulsing in this short range without standing up.
Stand up fully when the set is done.

Push-Up_Wide_Grip.name: Push-Up, Wide Grip
steps: Place your hands on the floor about one and a half shoulder-widths apart.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the floor, keeping your body straight.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

Push-Ups_-_Close_Triceps_Position.name: Push-Up, Close Grip
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands close together under your chest.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line with your body; do them on your knees if you can't keep it straight.

Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated.name: Decline Push-Up
steps: Place your feet on a bench or box behind you and your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your stomach tight so your hips don't sag.

Push_Jerk.name: Push Jerk
steps: Hold a barbell racked on the front of your shoulders, grip just outside them.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, torso upright.
Drive up hard and push the bar overhead, dropping into a quarter squat to catch it on straight arms.
Stand up with the bar overhead, then lower it to your shoulders.

Push_Press.name: Push Press
steps: Hold a barbell on the front of your shoulders with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly, keeping your upper body upright.
Drive up with your legs and use that push to press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, bending your knees slightly to soften the landing.
Move your head back to let the bar pass, then bring it forward under the bar at the top.

Pushups.name: Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders and step your feet back into a high plank.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor, elbows at a slight angle to your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line; do them on your knees or against a bench if you can't keep it straight.

Rack_Pull.name: Rack Pull
steps: Set the bar on the safety pins or blocks just below or above your knees.
Grip it just outside your legs with your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up tall with the bar.
Lower it back to the pins with control.

Reverse_Barbell_Curl.name: Barbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and your upper arms still.

Reverse_Crunch.name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your arms on the floor at your sides and your knees bent above your hips.
Squeeze your stomach to curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
Move slowly and don't swing your legs to lift your hips.

Reverse_Flyes.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward from your hips with your knees slightly bent, back flat and arms hanging below your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.
Keep your upper body still and lead the movement with your elbows.

Reverse_Grip_Bent-Over_Rows.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row, Underhand
steps: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, back flat and arms straight.
Pull the bar to your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat and don't stand up to move the bar.

Reverse_Grip_Triceps_Pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown, Underhand
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and hold it with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Stand tall facing the machine with your elbows tucked against your sides.
Straighten your arms to push the bar down to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows still at your sides and use a lighter weight than for the overhand version.

Reverse_Hyperextension.name: Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down on the reverse hyperextension machine with your hips at the edge of the pad and hold the handles.
Hook your ankles under the roller or strap, legs hanging down.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they're in line with your body.
Lower them slowly back down without letting them swing.
Keep your upper body on the pad and stop when your body is straight.

Reverse_Machine_Flyes.name: Machine Reverse Fly
steps: Sit facing the pad of a pec deck machine and set the handles to their rear position.
Hold the handles with your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Open your arms out to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Let them return slowly to the front.
Keep your chest against the pad and your shoulders down.

Ring_Row.name: Ring Row
steps: Hold the rings and lean back with straight arms, body straight.
Pull your chest up to the rings.
Lower with control.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

Romanian_Deadlift.name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep them at that angle.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, usually just below your knees.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Keep your back flat and the bar close to your legs throughout.

Romanian_Deadlift_Deficit.name: Romanian Deadlift, Deficit
steps: Stand on a low platform holding a barbell at your hips.
Push your hips back and lower the bar below the level of your feet, knees slightly bent.
Keep your back flat throughout.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Rowing_Machine.name: Rowing Machine
steps: Sit with your feet strapped in and grip the handle with straight arms.
Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Return in reverse order: arms, body, then legs.
Keep a steady rhythm.

Russian_Twist.name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the floor, or lifted for more challenge.
Lean back until you feel your stomach working, back straight, and hold your hands together in front of your chest.
Turn your upper body to one side, bringing your hands beside your hip.
Turn to the other side, and keep alternating.
Turn from your ribs, not just your arms, and keep your back straight.

Scapular_Pull-Up.name: Scapular Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together, lifting your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows straight throughout.
Relax back into a full hang and repeat.

Seal_Row.name: Seal Row
steps: Lie face down on a raised bench, high enough that your arms hang straight to the bar.
Grip the bar overhand, a little wider than your shoulders.
Row the bar up to the underside of the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
