Keep your chest on the pad and lower the bar until your arms are straight.

Seated_Band_Hip_Abduction.name: Seated Band Hip Abduction
steps: Sit on a bench with a loop band just above your knees.
Push your knees out against the band.
Hold for a moment.
Bring them back with control.

Seated_Band_Row.name: Seated Band Row
steps: Sit with your legs straight and a band looped around your feet.
Row the ends to your stomach.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

Seated_Barbell_Press.name: Seated Barbell Press, Back Supported
steps: Sit on an upright bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar at your upper chest with a grip just outside your shoulders, forearms vertical.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest, keeping your back on the pad.

Seated_Barbell_Triceps_Extension.name: Seated Barbell Triceps Extension
steps: Sit on a bench holding a barbell overhead with a narrow overhand grip.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
Keep your upper arms pointing up.
Straighten your arms back to the top.

Seated_Bent-Over_Rear_Delt_Raise.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly, Seated
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward until your chest is close to your thighs.
Let the dumbbells hang behind your calves, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are in line with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.
Keep your chest down and don't swing the weights up.

Seated_Cable_Row_One-Arm.name: Seated Cable Row, One-Arm
steps: Sit at a low-pulley row station holding a single handle in one hand.
Row the handle to your side, rotating slightly towards the arm.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return with control; finish the set and switch sides.

Seated_Cable_Row_Rope.name: Seated Cable Row, Rope
steps: Sit at a low-pulley row station holding the rope ends.
Row the rope to your stomach, pulling the ends apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

Seated_Cable_Row_V-Bar.name: Seated Cable Row, V-Bar
steps: Sit at a low-pulley row station holding a V-bar.
Row it to your stomach, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

Seated_Cable_Row_Wide_Grip.name: Seated Cable Row, Wide Grip
steps: Sit at a low-pulley row station holding a long bar with a wide overhand grip.
Row the bar to your upper stomach with your elbows out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

Seated_Cable_Rows.name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit at a low-pulley row station with your feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, holding the handle with both hands.
Sit tall with your arms straight.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together and keeping your elbows close to your body.
Let it return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your back straight and your upper body upright; don't rock back to pull.

Seated_Calf_Raise.name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads on your lower thighs.
Lift the pads slightly and release the safety lever.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can for a stretch.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Move slowly through the whole range; don't bounce at the bottom.

Seated_Dumbbell_Calf_Raise.name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a plate or step.
Rest a dumbbell on each thigh just above the knee.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower slowly until your heels are below your toes.

Seated_Dumbbell_Curl.name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging, palms forward.
Bend your elbows to curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your torso upright.
Lower the dumbbells until your arms are straight.

Seated_Dumbbell_Curl_Alternating.name: Seated Dumbbell Curl, Alternating
steps: Sit on the end of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up, turning your palm up as you lift.
Lower it and curl the other.
Keep your back straight.

Seated_Dumbbell_Press.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with an upright back and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your stomach and keep your back against the pad.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Don't arch your lower back to push the weight up.

Seated_Dumbbell_Press_Neutral_Grip.name: Seated Dumbbell Press, Neutral Grip
steps: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells at your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Lower them to your shoulders with control.

Seated_Dumbbell_Shrug.name: Seated Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Sit upright on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your arms straight and your back upright; move straight up and down without rolling your shoulders.

Seated_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.name: Seated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
steps: Sit on the end of a flat bench and hold one dumbbell overhead in both hands, cupped under its top end.
Keep your upper arms beside your head and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arms to raise it back overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your head.

Seated_Good_Morning.name: Seated Good Morning
steps: Sit on a bench with a barbell across your upper back and your feet wide.
Lean forward from your hips with your back flat.
Go as low as you can without rounding.
Raise your torso back up.

Seated_Knee_Tuck.name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and place your hands behind you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your knees bent.
Pull your knees towards your chest, then extend your legs out without touching the floor.
Keep your torso still and your back straight.

Seated_Leg_Curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot point, and sit with the lower pad just above your heels.
Lower the thigh pad onto your legs so they're held in place, then hold the handles.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Let the pad return slowly until your legs are nearly straight.
Keep your back against the pad and move slowly.

Seated_Side_Lateral_Raise.name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands are at shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

Shoulder_Dislocate.name: Shoulder Dislocate
steps: Hold a stick or band in front of your thighs with a wide grip.
Keeping your arms straight, lift it overhead and behind you until it reaches your lower back.
Bring it back over to the front.
Use a wider grip if you have to bend your elbows.

Shoulder_Press_-_With_Bands.name: Band Shoulder Press
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand at your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and stand tall.
Press your hands up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
Don't lean back or arch your lower back as you press.

Shrimp_Squat.name: Shrimp Squat
steps: Stand on one leg, bend the other knee and hold that foot behind you with the same-side hand.
Squat down on the standing leg until the back knee touches the floor lightly.
Keep your chest up and your standing heel flat.
Drive back up to standing, then finish the set and switch legs.

Side-Lying_Dumbbell_External_Rotation.name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
steps: Lie on your side holding a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees against your side.
Rotate your forearm up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow in place.
Lower slowly.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Side_Bridge.name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your legs straight, one foot on top of the other.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position for the time you've set, breathing steadily.
Lower your hips, then switch sides.
Keep your hips up and in line; don't let them drop or rotate.

Side_Lateral_Raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands are at shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.
Lead with your elbows, don't swing, and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

Side_Plank_Hip_Dip.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
steps: Lie on your side on one forearm, elbow under your shoulder, legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips until they almost touch the floor, then lift them back up.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Side_Plank_Leg_Raise.name: Side Plank Leg Raise
steps: Get into a side plank on one forearm with your legs stacked.
Lift your top leg as high as you can, keeping it straight.
Lower it with control without letting your hips drop.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

Side_Plank_Rotation.name: Side Plank Rotation
steps: Get into a side plank on one forearm with your top arm reaching to the ceiling.
Reach your top arm under your body and rotate your chest towards the floor.
Rotate back and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips up throughout, then switch sides.

Side_Plank_with_Dumbbell_Raise.name: Side Plank with Dumbbell Raise
steps: Get into a side plank on one forearm, holding a dumbbell in the top hand.
Raise the dumbbell straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower it with control.
Keep your hips up; finish the set and switch sides.

Single-Leg_Calf_Raise.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand on one foot on a step or the floor, holding a wall for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly until your heel is below the step or on the floor.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

Single-Leg_Hip_Thrust.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until your body is level from knee to shoulder.
Lower with control, then finish the set and switch legs.

Single_Arm_Dumbbell_Press.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press, One-Arm
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold one dumbbell at your shoulder, palm forward.
Press it straight up until your arm is locked out over your shoulder.
Keep your torso upright without leaning to the side.
Lower the dumbbell to your shoulder, finish the set and switch arms.

Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and arms by your sides.
Straighten one leg so it's in line with your other thigh.
Push through the heel on the floor to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee.
Lower your hips slowly, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your hips level; don't let the side of the raised leg drop.

Sissy_Squat.name: Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a post or rail beside you for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, then bend your knees and push them forward while leaning your upper body back, keeping a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in the front of your thighs, then push through the balls of your feet to stand back up.
Keep your hips straight throughout; the movement comes from the knees, not from bending at the waist.

Sit-Up.name: Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, anchored under something if needed.
Cross your arms on your chest or place your hands lightly beside your head.
Curl your upper body up until your chest is close to your knees.
Lower yourself slowly back down.
Don't pull on your head or neck to get up.

Sled_Push.name: Sled Push
steps: Grip the sled handles with your arms straight or bent, leaning forward.
Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps.
Keep your back flat.
Push for the set distance.

Smith_Machine_Behind-the-Neck_Press.name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Neck Press
steps: Sit on a bench under the Smith machine bar, the bar behind your head.
Unhook it and press it up until your arms are straight.
Lower it to the base of your neck.
Use a light weight.

Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Place a flat bench under the Smith machine so the bar lines up with the middle of your chest.
Lie back, hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and turn it to release it from the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, and turn it to hook it back when you finish.
Set the safety stops just above your chest before you start.

Smith_Machine_Bench_Press_Close_Grip.name: Smith Machine Bench Press, Close Grip
steps: Lie on a flat bench under the Smith machine bar, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up.
Hook the bar when you finish.

Smith_Machine_Calf_Raise.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Place a step or plate under the Smith machine bar and set the bar at about shoulder height.
Step under it with the bar across your upper back and the balls of your feet on the step.
Straighten your legs, release the bar and lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Keep your knees straight but not locked, and don't bounce at the bottom.

Smith_Machine_Deadlift.name: Smith Machine Deadlift
steps: Set the Smith machine bar low and stand with it over your mid-foot.
Squat down and grip it, back flat.
Stand up tall.
Lower it back down with control.

Smith_Machine_Decline_Press.name: Smith Machine Decline Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench under the Smith machine bar.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your lower chest.
Press it back up.
Hook the bar when you finish.

Smith_Machine_Drag_Curl.name: Smith Machine Drag Curl
steps: Stand holding the Smith machine bar underhand at your thighs.
Pull your elbows back as you curl, dragging the bar up along your body.
Stop at your lower chest.
Lower along the same path.

Smith_Machine_Front_Squat.name: Smith Machine Front Squat
steps: Hold the Smith machine bar across your front shoulders, elbows high.
Unhook it and squat until your thighs are parallel.
Drive back up.
Hook the bar when you finish.

Smith_Machine_Good_Morning.name: Smith Machine Good Morning
steps: Stand with the Smith machine bar on your upper back.
Push your hips back and lower your torso towards level.
Keep your back flat.
Raise your torso back up.

Smith_Machine_Hip_Thrust.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the padded Smith machine bar across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knee to shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

Smith_Machine_Incline_Press.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench under the Smith machine bar.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your upper chest.
Press it back up.
Hook the bar when you finish.

Smith_Machine_Kneeling_Squat.name: Smith Machine Kneeling Squat
steps: Kneel on a pad under the Smith machine bar with it on your upper back.
Sit your hips back towards your heels.
Drive your hips forward to come back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

Smith_Machine_Lunge.name: Smith Machine Lunge
steps: Stand under the Smith machine bar with it on your upper back.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs.

Smith_Machine_Overhead_Shoulder_Press.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Place a bench with an upright back under the Smith machine so the bar comes down just in front of your face.
Sit down, hold the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and turn it to release it from the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly to about chin height.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, then turn it to hook it back when you finish.
Keep your back against the pad and your stomach braced.

Smith_Machine_Reverse_Lunge.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand under the Smith machine bar with it on your upper back.
Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return.
Finish the set and switch legs.

Smith_Machine_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand holding the Smith machine bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

Smith_Machine_Row.name: Smith Machine Row
steps: Hinge forward holding the Smith machine bar, back flat.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

Smith_Machine_Shrug.name: Smith Machine Shrug
steps: Stand holding the Smith machine bar at your thighs.
Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.

Smith_Machine_Sissy_Squat.name: Smith Machine Sissy Squat
steps: Stand under the Smith machine bar with it on your upper back, feet slightly forward.
Bend your knees forward and lean back as you lower.
Go as low as you comfortably can.
Push back up through your quads.

Smith_Machine_Squat.name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under it so it sits across your upper back.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of the bar, then turn the bar to release it.
Bend your knees and hips to squat until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Set the safety stops just below your lowest point, and keep your knees in line with your toes.

Smith_Machine_Upright_Row.name: Smith Machine Upright Row
steps: Stand holding the Smith machine bar at your thighs, overhand.
Pull it up to just below your chin, elbows high.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.

Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height and step under it so it sits across your upper back.
Take a long step forward with one foot and keep the other behind you on its toes, then release the bar.
Bend both knees to lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping most of your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to rise back up, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your upper body upright and your front knee in line with your toes.

Snatch.name: Snatch
steps: Set up over a barbell on the floor with a wide snatch grip, hips low, back flat, arms straight.
Lift the bar off the floor, then extend your hips and knees explosively as it passes your thighs.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it locked out overhead at the bottom of a full squat.
Stand up with the bar overhead, then lower it.

Snatch-Grip_High_Pull.name: Snatch-Grip High Pull
steps: Set up over the bar with a wide snatch grip.
Lift the bar and extend your hips and knees explosively.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high and out.
Lower the bar with control.

Snatch-Grip_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Snatch-Grip Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your hips with a wide snatch grip.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Go down until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Snatch_Balance.name: Snatch Balance
steps: Set a barbell on your upper back with a wide snatch grip.
Dip slightly, then drive the bar up and drop under it into an overhead squat.
Catch it with straight arms at the bottom.
Stand up with the bar locked out overhead.

Snatch_Grip_Deadlift.name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and take a wide snatch grip, back flat, arms straight.
Your hips start lower and your torso flatter than in a normal deadlift.
Push through your feet and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Finish tall with the bar against your upper thighs, then lower it under control.

Snatch_Pull.name: Snatch Pull
steps: Set up over the bar with a wide snatch grip.
Lift the bar from the floor as for a snatch, keeping it close to your legs.
Extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively and shrug at the top.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

Sots_Press.name: Sots Press
steps: Squat to the bottom of a front squat with a barbell on your shoulders.
Stay in the squat and press the bar overhead behind your head.
Lower it back to your shoulders with control.
Keep your chest up and heels down throughout.

Sphinx_Push-Up.name: Sphinx Push-Up
steps: Start in a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your palms into the floor and straighten your arms to lift your forearms off.
Lower back down onto your forearms with control.
Keep your body in a straight line throughout.

Spider_Curl.name: Spider Curl
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest near the top, holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight down in front of the bench.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your biceps, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the bench and don't swing the bar.

Split_Jerk.name: Split Jerk
steps: Hold a barbell racked on the front of your shoulders, grip just outside them.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, torso upright.
Drive the bar up and split your feet, one forward and one back, catching it on straight arms.
Bring your feet back together with the bar overhead, then lower it to your shoulders.

Split_Squat_Jump.name: Split Squat Jump
steps: Stand in a split stance, one foot forward and the other back, and lower into a split squat.
Jump straight up from the bottom position.
Land in the same split stance with soft knees and lower into the next rep.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and take a long step forward with one foot.
Lift the heel of your back foot so you're on the ball of that foot.
Bend both knees to lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your upper body upright.
Push through your front foot to rise back up, keeping your feet in place, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your front knee in line with your toes.

Spoto_Press.name: Spoto Press
steps: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar with your bench press grip.
Lower the bar until it is a few centimetres above your chest.
Hold it there without touching your chest.
Press it back up to straight arms.

Sprawl.name: Sprawl
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with your knees slightly bent.
Drop your hands to the floor and shoot your legs back, letting your hips sink towards the floor.
Keep your chest up and your arms straight as your hips touch down.
Snap your feet back under you and return to the athletic stance.

Squat_Thrust.name: Squat Thrust
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back so your body is in a straight plank.
Jump your feet back in towards your hands.
Stand up fully and go straight into the next rep.

Standing_Barbell_Calf_Raise.name: Barbell Calf Raise
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back from a rack and stand with the balls of your feet on a sturdy plate or step.
Stand tall with your knees straight but not locked.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Move slowly and keep your balance; start without the step if you feel unsteady.

Standing_Barbell_Press_Behind_Neck.name: Barbell Behind-the-Neck Press
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and hold it with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Step under the bar so it rests across your upper back, lift it out and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Press the bar straight up from behind your head until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly behind your head until it's at about ear level.
Keep your head still and facing forward, and only lower the bar as far as your shoulders move comfortably.

Standing_Barbell_Rollout.name: Standing Barbell Rollout
steps: Stand with a loaded barbell on the floor in front of you and grip it with your arms straight.
Roll the bar forward, lowering your body towards the floor with your body straight.
Go as far as you can without letting your lower back sag.
Pull the bar back in to standing.

Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl.name: Cable Curl
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall facing the machine with your arms straight and your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and don't lean back.

Standing_Cable_Crunch.name: Standing Cable Crunch
steps: Stand facing away from a high pulley holding the rope beside your head.
Crunch forward and down, bringing your ribs towards your hips.
Return with control.
Keep your hips still.

Standing_Cable_Leg_Curl.name: Standing Cable Leg Curl
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face it.
Curl your heel up towards your buttock.
Lower with control.
Finish the set and switch legs.

Standing_Cable_Row.name: Standing Cable Row
steps: Stand facing a low pulley in a split stance holding a bar or handles.
Hinge slightly and row towards your stomach.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop.name: Cable Woodchop
steps: Set a pulley high and stand side-on to it, feet about shoulder-width apart, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with your arms straight and your hands up towards the pulley, turned towards it.
Pull the handle down and across your body towards the opposite knee, turning your upper body and pivoting your back foot.
Return slowly to the start, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your arms nearly straight and turn from your stomach, not only your arms.

Standing_Calf_Raises.name: Machine Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the machine with your shoulders under the pads and the balls of your feet on the edge of the step.
Straighten your legs to lift the weight, knees straight but not locked.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Keep your knees straight and don't bounce at the bottom.

Standing_Dumbbell_Calf_Raise.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or plate, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with your knees straight but not locked.
Lower your heels slowly as far as you can.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, then pause.
Hold one dumbbell and a support with your other hand if you need help balancing.

Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell with both hands under the top plate, arms straight above your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Lower it until you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Straighten your arms to lift the dumbbell back above your head.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your stomach braced so your lower back doesn't arch.

Standing_Dumbbell_Upright_Row.name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Lift the dumbbells up along the front of your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows are at about shoulder height and the dumbbells are at your lower chest.
Lower them slowly back to your thighs.
Keep the dumbbells close to your body and stop lower if your shoulders feel pinched.

Standing_Leg_Curl.name: Standing Leg Curl
steps: Stand at the machine with the pad behind the ankle of one leg and your knee lined up with the pivot point.
Hold the handles and keep your standing leg slightly bent.
Curl your heel up towards your glute as far as you can.
Lower it slowly until your leg is straight, then switch legs after the set.
Keep your hips and upper body still.

Standing_Low-Pulley_Deltoid_Raise.name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine, so the cable crosses in front of you.
Hold the machine with your other hand and keep your elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out to the side until your hand is at shoulder height.
Lower it slowly back across your body, then switch sides after the set.
Keep your upper body still and don't lean away to lift the weight.

Standing_Military_Press.name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about shoulder height and hold it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift it out so it sits on the front of your shoulders, and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back to let it pass, until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach so you don't lean back.

Standing_Overhead_Barbell_Triceps_Extens.name: Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall and hold a barbell above your head with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Lower it until you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Straighten your arms to press the bar back up.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your stomach braced.

Star_Jump.name: Star Jump
steps: Stand with your feet together and drop into a quarter squat, arms down.
Jump as high as you can, spreading your arms and legs into an X in the air.
Bring your arms and legs back together before you land.
Land softly with bent knees and reset before the next jump.

Stiff-Legged_Barbell_Deadlift.name: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees nearly straight, with only a slight bend.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs as far as you can with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Keep your back flat throughout; stop lowering when it starts to round.

Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep them at that angle.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Keep your back flat and the dumbbells close to your legs throughout.

Straight-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover.name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands cupping one end.
Keep your arms nearly straight, with only a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your chest and under your arms.
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your hips on the bench and don't lower further than your shoulders are comfortable with.

Straight-Arm_Pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, holding the bar with an overhand grip.
Step back and lean forward slightly from your hips, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly back to about head height.
Keep your elbows only slightly bent and don't bend them to pull.

Sumo_Deadlift.name: Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grip the bar with your hands inside your legs, arms straight.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and push your knees out over your toes.
Push the floor away and stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lower the bar the same way with a flat back.

Sumo_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Sumo Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand in a wide stance, toes out, holding a barbell with your hands inside your legs.
Push your hips back and lower the bar towards your shins, knees slightly bent.
Keep your back flat and stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Superman.name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with your arms straight overhead and your legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a moment while squeezing your glutes and back.
Lower with control.

Superman_Pull.name: Superman Pull
steps: Lie face down with your arms straight overhead, chest and arms lifted off the floor.
Pull your elbows down towards your ribs as if doing a pull-up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then reach forward again.
Keep your chest off the floor throughout.

T-Bar_Row_with_Handle.name: T-Bar Row
steps: Set one end of a barbell in a landmine or a corner, put plates on the other end and straddle the bar facing the plates.
Place a close-grip handle under the bar next to the plates and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward with a flat back, arms straight.
Pull the plates up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
Keep your back flat and your upper body still throughout.

Tate_Press.name: Tate Press
steps: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows out to the sides, lowering the dumbbells to touch your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms back up.

Thigh_Abductor.name: Machine Hip Abduction
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and the pads on the outside of your knees.
Hold the handles and start with your legs together.
Push your knees out to the sides as far as you comfortably can.
Let them come back together slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and control the return.

Thigh_Adductor.name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and the pads on the inside of your knees.
Set the start position so your legs are open to a comfortable stretch.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet.
Let them open slowly back to the start.
Keep your back against the pad and don't let the weight pull your legs open quickly.

Toes_to_Bar.name: Toes to Bar
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip.
Brace your stomach and lift your legs until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs with control, without swinging.
Bend your knees slightly if your hamstrings are tight.

Trap_Bar_Carry.name: Trap Bar Carry
steps: Stand inside a trap bar and lift it by the handles.
Stand tall with your shoulders back and your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Stop and set the bar down with a flat back.

Trap_Bar_Deadlift.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Stand in the middle of a trap bar with your feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to hold the handles at your sides, arms straight.
Flatten your back, brace your stomach and lift your chest.
Push through your feet to stand up tall.
Lower the bar to the floor the same way, keeping your back flat.

Trap_Bar_Floor_Press.name: Trap Bar Floor Press
steps: Lie on the floor inside a trap bar's frame with the handles beside your chest.
Grip the handles with palms facing in.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.

Trap_Bar_Overhead_Press.name: Trap Bar Overhead Press
steps: Clean or lift a trap bar to your shoulders, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your shoulders.

Trap_Bar_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand inside a trap bar holding the handles, standing tall.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs, knees slightly bent.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

Trap_Bar_Row.name: Trap Bar Row
steps: Stand inside a trap bar, hinge forward and grip the handles.
Keep your back flat, torso at about 45 degrees.
Row the handles up towards your hips.
Lower with control.

Trap_Bar_Shrug.name: Trap Bar Shrug
steps: Stand inside a trap bar and lift it by the handles, arms straight at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control.

Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
steps: Place one knee and the same hand on a bench, back flat, holding a dumbbell in your other hand.
Lift that upper arm until it's in line with your body, elbow bent and forearm hanging down.
Straighten your arm behind you until it's fully straight.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to the start, then switch arms after the set.
Keep your upper arm still; only your forearm should move.

Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a pulley and stand facing away from it, holding the ends above and behind your head.
Step forward into a staggered stance and lean forward slightly, elbows bent and pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to push the rope forward and up until your arms are straight.
Let your hands return slowly behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still beside your head.

Triceps_Pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley and hold it with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall facing the machine with your elbows tucked against your sides.
Straighten your arms to push the bar down to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows still at your sides and don't lean over the bar.

Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment.name: Triceps Pushdown, Rope
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold the ends with your palms facing each other.
Stand tall facing the machine with your elbows tucked against your sides.
Straighten your arms to push the rope down, separating the ends at the bottom.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.

Triceps_Pushdown_One-Arm_Underhand.name: Triceps Pushdown, One-Arm Underhand
steps: Stand facing a high pulley holding a single handle underhand.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Return; finish the set and switch sides.

Triceps_Pushdown_V-Bar.name: Triceps Pushdown, V-Bar
steps: Stand facing a high pulley holding a V-bar.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Return with control.

Tuck_Jump.name: Tuck Jump
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and dip into a quarter squat.
Jump straight up and pull your knees towards your chest at the top.
Release your legs and land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Rebound straight into the next jump, or reset if your landing gets sloppy.

Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Military_Press.name: Double Kettlebell Press
steps: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, handles in your palms and the bells against your forearms.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
Press both kettlebells up until your arms are straight above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes so you don't lean back.

Underhand_Cable_Pulldowns.name: Lat Pulldown, Underhand
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, bringing your elbows down towards your ribs.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing back to pull.

Upright_Barbell_Row.name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar up along the front of your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows are at about shoulder height and the bar is at your lower chest.
Lower it slowly back to your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body and stop lower if your shoulders feel pinched.

V-Bar_Pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown, V-Bar
steps: Attach a close-grip handle to the lat pulldown cable and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the handle with your palms facing each other, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and pull the handle to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing back to pull.

Waiter_Carry.name: Waiter Carry
steps: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand with your palm facing up, like a tray.
Keep your arm straight and your wrist stacked over your shoulder.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Lower the dumbbell, switch hands and walk back.

Wall_Angel.name: Wall Angel
steps: Stand with your back, head and buttocks against a wall.
Raise your arms into a goal-post position with the backs of your hands on the wall.
Slide your arms up overhead, keeping them in contact with the wall.
Slide them back down.

Wall_Sit.name: Wall Sit
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about half a metre in front of it.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, knees over your ankles.
Hold with your back flat on the wall.
Slide back up when the time is up.

Weighted_Pull_Ups.name: Weighted Pull-Up
steps: Attach a plate to a dipping belt around your hips, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold a pull-up bar with your palms facing away, hands slightly wider than your shoulders, and hang with straight arms.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Only add weight once you can do strict pull-ups easily, and don't swing.

Wide-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.name: Barbell Bench Press, Wide Grip
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands clearly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together, and use a spotter or safety arms.

Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown, Wide Grip
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away, hands wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and don't swing your body to pull the bar down.

Z_Press.name: Z Press
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front and your torso upright.
Hold the bar at your upper chest with a grip just outside your shoulders.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight, without leaning back.
Lower it to your upper chest under control.

Zercher_Carry.name: Zercher Carry
steps: Hold a barbell in the crooks of your elbows, hands together in front of your chest.
Stand tall with your elbows close to your body and your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps.
Stop, lower the bar to a rack or blocks and rest.

Zercher_Squat.name: Zercher Squat
steps: Hold a barbell in the crooks of your elbows, hands clasped in front of your chest.
Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips.
Squat down to parallel or below, torso upright, elbows between your knees.
Push through your feet to stand back up.

Zottman_Curl.name: Zottman Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
At the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with your palms facing down, then turn them back up at the bottom.
Keep your elbows by your sides throughout.
